auth.signUpDescription.text: Kola akawunti yo otandike okugezesebwa kwa nnaku musanvu okw'obwereere.

auth.resetDescription.en: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetDescription.text: Yingiza email yo era tujja kukusindikira akakwate okuteekawo ekisumuluzo ekipya.

auth.resetSent.en: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.resetSent.text: Bwe kiba nti akawunti eriwo ku email eyo, olukalala lw'okukyusa luli mu kkubo. Kebera mu inbox yo.

auth.newPasswordDescription.en: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.newPasswordDescription.text: Londa akasumuluzo akapya ku akaawunti yo.

auth.resetLinkInvalid.en: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
auth.resetLinkInvalid.text: Akakwate kano akaddamu kakadde oba kaakozesebwa dda. Saba akapya.

auth.confirmEmailDescription.en: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it to finish creating your account.
auth.confirmEmailDescription.text: Twakutumidde akakwate okukakasa ku email yo. Kiggule okumaliriza okutondawo akawunti yo.

auth.errors.emailNotConfirmed.text: Okakasizza email yo okusooka. Kebera mu inbox yo olabe linki.

auth.errors.weakPassword.en: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
auth.errors.weakPassword.text: Londa akasumuluzo akakakali: nga kalina waakiri ennukuta munaana, ng'alimu ennukuta emu n'omuwendo gumu.

auth.errors.alreadyRegistered.en: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.errors.alreadyRegistered.text: Akawunti n'ekyuma kya email kino kyamala dda okubaawo. Yingira mu kifo kyayo.

auth.errors.network.en: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.errors.network.text: Tewali kuyunga ku server. Kebera ennyungo yo era ogezeeko nate.

auth.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errors.generic.text: Waliwo ekintu ekyagenze obubi. Nkwegayiridde gezaako nate.

auth.errors.tooManyAttempts.en: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.errors.tooManyAttempts.text: Okugezaako kungi nnyo. Nsaba olindirire eddakiika entono ogende ogezeeko nate.

progress.description.en: The days you have prayed with Ave.
progress.description.text: Ennaku ze wabadde osaba ne Ave.

progress.novenaStart.en: Pray the first day today to begin.

progress.novenaComplete.en: Novena complete. May God bless your intentions.

feedback.tooMany.text: Webale nnyo olw'okuddamu kwonna. Bambi linda eddakiika ntono nga tonatuma birala.

routine.description.en: Choose the prayers you want to pray each day and week.
routine.description.text: Londa essaala z'oyagala okusaba buli lunaku ne buli wiiki.

routine.ownHint.text: Tewali ku bino ekikwatagana? Zimba enkola yo ey'okukola okuva mu kusaba kwonna mu Ave.

routine.promptText.text: Ave asobola okukuteerawo essaala z'okusaba buli lunaku oba buli wiiki. Okkiriza emu, ogikyusaamu, oba ogibuuka.

routine.weeklyDescription.en: The Divine Mercy Chaplet and the Stations of the Cross on Fridays, and the Magnificat for Our Lady on Saturdays.
routine.weeklyDescription.text: Essaala ya Divine Mercy Chaplet n'eya Stations of the Cross ku Lwokutaano, ne Magnificat eya Our Lady ku Lwomukaaga.

routine.fullDescription.en: Morning, midday and night prayers and the Rosary every day, with the Divine Mercy Chaplet on Fridays.
routine.fullDescription.text: Okusaba okw'oku makya, okw'emisana n'okw'ekiro n'okusoma Rosari buli lunaku, n'okusaba kwa Divine Mercy Chaplet ku Lwokutaano.

seasons.holyName.en: the Most Holy Name of Jesus

routine.addDescription.en: Choose the days you want to pray this prayer.

billing.includes.en: Your plan includes every prayer in all three languages, audio, streaks, sharing and reminders.
billing.includes.text: Enteekateeka yo erimu buli ssaala mu nnimi zonna essatu, eddoboozi, okukwatagana n'okujjukizibwa.

billing.description.en: Every prayer, in English, Luganda and Runyankore, with audio, streaks, sharing and reminders.
billing.description.text: Buli ssaala mu Lungereza, Oluganda n'Olunyankole, nga mulimu amaloboozi, okukubaganya ebirowoozo n'okujjukizibwa.

billing.signInFirst.en: Create a free account to start your 7-day free trial.
billing.signInFirst.text: Kola akawunta ey'obwereere okutandika okugezesebwa kw'ennaku omusanvu.

billing.trialEnded.en: Your free trial has ended. Choose a plan to keep praying with Ave.
billing.trialEnded.text: Okugezesebwa kwo okw'obwereere kuwedde. Londa entegeka okusigala ng'osaba ne Ave.

billing.methodsUganda.en: Pay with MTN or Airtel mobile money, or a card. Payments are handled securely by PesaPal.
billing.methodsUganda.text: Sasula ne MTN oba Airtel mobile money, oba kaadi. Okusasula kukolebwa mu ngeri etaliimu bulabe PesaPal.

billing.methodsAbroad.en: Pay with Visa or Mastercard. Payments are handled securely by PesaPal.
billing.methodsAbroad.text: Sasula ne Visa oba Mastercard. Okusasula kukolebwa mu ngeri ey'obukuumi nga PesaPal bw'ekola.

billing.startFailed.text: Teyasobola kutandika kusasula. Kebera enkolagana yo era ogezeeko nate.

billing.notPaidText.en: The payment didn't go through, so nothing was charged. You can try again.
billing.notPaidText.text: Okusasula tekwagenda bulungi, n’olwekyo tewali kyasasulwa. Osobola okugezaako nate.

billing.checkLater.en: We couldn't confirm your payment yet. If money was taken, your plan will be activated shortly. Contact us if it isn't.
billing.checkLater.text: Tetunnaba kumanya oba okusasula kwakoleddwa. Singa ssente zaatwaliddwa, enteekateeka yo ejja kutandika mu bbanga ttono. Tukwatagane naffe singa tekikoleddwa.

novena.keepGoing.en: Keep going: you can still finish the novena.

novena.ended.en: This novena's days are over. It comes round again next year.
novena.ended.text: Ennaku z'ekikungo kino zimaze okuggwaako. Kijja kuddamu omwaka ogujja.

reminders.off.en: Get a notification when it's time for each prayer in your routine.
reminders.off.text: Funa okutegeezebwa buli lwe kituuka ekiseera eky'okusaba mu nteekateeka yo.

reminders.on.text: Obujjukizo buli ku ssimu eno. Ojja kufuna ekimu buli kiseera ky'okusaba.

reminders.testBody.en: Reminders are working. God bless your prayer.
reminders.testBody.text: Okujjukizibwa kukola. Katonda akuwe omukisa mu kusaba kwo.

reminders.testSent.en: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
reminders.testSent.text: Okukebera kutumiddwa. Kigenda okutuuka mu sekonda ntono.

reminders.signIn.en: Sign in to get reminders for your routine.
reminders.signIn.text: Yingira okufuna obujjukizo ku by'okukola bulijjo.

reminders.unsupported.text: Akasunsuzi kano tekayinza kulaga byakujjukiza. Kozesa Chrome ku Android, oba teekako Ave ku iPhone yo.

reminders.denied.en: Notifications are blocked for Ave. Allow them in your phone's settings, then come back here.
reminders.denied.text: Okulabula kuziyiziddwa ku Ave. Bakkirize mu nteekateeka ya essimu yo, olwo okomewo wano.

reminders.installFirst.text: Ku iPhone, okujjukizibwa kukola nga Ave ali ku sikuliini yo ey'awaka: kozesa Share, olwo oyongere ku sikuliini y'awaka, era ogule Ave okuva awo.

reminders.failed.en: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
reminders.failed.text: Waliwo ekintu ekyagenze obubi. Kebera ennyungirizo yo era ogezeeko nate.

splash.accountNote.en: 7 days free, then UGX 7,000 a month in Uganda or USD 3.99 abroad.
splash.accountNote.text: Ennaku 7 ez'obwereere, olwo UGX 7,000 buli mwezi mu Uganda oba USD 3.99 ebweru wa Uganda.

account.deleteText.en: This permanently deletes your account, your progress, favourites, prayer routine, reminders and feedback. It can't be undone.
account.deleteText.text: Kino kizikiriza ddala akawunti yo, okukulaakulana kwo, ebintu by'oyagala, enkola y'okusaba, ebyokujjukizibwa n'ebiwandiiko. Tekisobola kukyusibwa.

account.deleteFailed.text: Teyasobola kuggyawo akawunti yo. Kebera enkolagana yo era ogezeeko nate.

auth.errors.alreadyRegistered.text: Akawunti erimu e-mayiro egi eriho. Taahamu omu mwanya gw'ekyo.

auth.errors.weakPassword.en: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
auth.errors.weakPassword.text: Toorana akasumuruzo k'amaani: kakye munonga obubonero 8, n'akabonero kamwe hamwe n'enamba emwe.

auth.errors.tooManyAttempts.en: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.errors.tooManyAttempts.text: Okugyezaho kwingi munonga. Nyabura we rinda edakiika nkye ogaruke ogyezeho.

auth.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errors.generic.text: Hariho ekintu ekyabaire kigwire. Nyabura we gezaho ogaruke.

auth.errors.network.en: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.errors.network.text: Tikirikubaasa kuhika aha seva. Kyebera okukwatanisa kwawe kandi ogaruke ogyezeho.

progress.description.en: The days you have prayed with Ave.

progress.empty.en: Mark a prayer as prayed to start tracking your progress.
progress.empty.text: Kora akamanyiso aha kushaba kwawe okutandika kukuratira entunguuka yaawe.

progress.signInToKeep.en: Sign in to keep your progress and favourites on all your devices.
progress.signInToKeep.text: Yambuka okurinda entunguuka yaawe n'ebirikukundwa aha byoma byawe byona.

progress.novenaStart.en: Pray the first day today to begin.
progress.novenaStart.text: Shaba omu izooba ry'okubanza eriizooba okutandika.

progress.novenaComplete.en: Novena complete. May God bless your intentions.
progress.novenaComplete.text: Novena ehwaireho. Ruhanga abaase kugira ngu ekigyendererwa kyawe kikuhwe omugisha.

progress.novenaRule.en: Pray on consecutive days. Missing a day starts the novena again.
progress.novenaRule.text: Shaba aha biro ebirikukurataho. Okufeerwa eizooba nikigaruka kutandika novena.

favourites.empty.en: Use "Save to favourites" on any prayer to keep it here.
favourites.empty.text: Kozesa "Save to favourites" aha kushaba kwona okukubaasa kukigumya aha.

rosary.faithHopeCharity.en: For an increase in faith, hope and charity
rosary.faithHopeCharity.text: Okwongyera aha kwikiriza, okuhira amatsiko hamwe n'obuyambi

update.ready.en: A new version of Ave is ready.

home.greetingSubtitle.en: Let us begin our day with prayer.

home.greetingSubtitleAfternoon.en: Pause for a moment with God.

home.greetingSubtitleEvening.en: Let us end our day with prayer.
home.greetingSubtitleEvening.text: Reka turugye omu eizooba ryaitu n'okushaba.

auth.passwordInvalid.en: Use at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
auth.passwordInvalid.text: Kozesa haakiri abantu 8, hamwe n'obu haraabe hariho enyuguta emwe hamwe n'enamba.

legal.privacyHint.en: What information Ave keeps and why
legal.privacyHint.text: Ni amakuru ki agu Ave arikubiika kandi ahabwenki

legal.englishOnly.en: This page is available in English only.
legal.englishOnly.text: Orupapura oru nirushangwa omuri Rungyereza rwonka.

feedback.hint.en: Report a problem or a translation mistake, or share an idea
feedback.hint.text: Ripoota oburemeezi nainga enshobi y'okuvunuura, nainga ogabane ekiteekateeko

feedback.description.en: Tell us what to improve, report a problem, or point out a translation mistake. You don't need an account.
feedback.description.text: Tugambire eki ky'okutunguura, oyetomboitwe aha buremeezi, nainga oyorekye enshobi y'okuvunuura. Torikwetenga akawunti.

feedback.translationPlaceholder.en: Which prayer, which language, and what should it say?
feedback.translationPlaceholder.text: Ni kushaba ki, orurimi ki, kandi niki eki kushemereire kugamba?

feedback.emailHint.en: Only if you would like a reply.

feedback.sent.en: Thank you. Your feedback has been sent.

feedback.failed.en: Couldn't send your feedback. Check your connection and try again, or email us at
feedback.failed.text: Tikabaasa kwohereza okugarukamu kwawe. Kyebera enkoragana yaawe kandi ogaruke ogyezeho, nainga otusindikire e-mayiro ahari

feedback.tooMany.en: Thank you for all your feedback. Please wait a few minutes before sending more.
feedback.tooMany.text: Webare okugarukamu kwawe kwona. Nyabura we rinda edakiika nkye otakasindikire endiijo.

auth.errors.waitBeforeResend.en: We just sent you an email. Please wait a minute before asking for another one.
auth.errors.waitBeforeResend.text: Tukakusindikira e-mayiro. Nyabura we rinda edakiika emwe otakashaba endiijo.

progress.milestoneKeepGoing.en: Thanks be to God. Keep going!

progress.daysToGo.en: more days to go. Keep praying!
progress.daysToGo.text: Hariho ebiro bingi ebirikugyenda. Guma nooshaba!

routine.description.en: Choose the prayers you want to pray each day and week.
routine.description.text: Toorana okushaba oku orikwenda kushaba buri izooba n'esande.

routine.ownHint.en: None of these fit? Build your own routine from any prayer in Ave.
routine.ownHint.text: Tihariho ekirikuhikaana? Yombeka omuringo gwawe kuruga omu kushaba kwona omuri Ave.

routine.simpleDescription.en: Begin and end each day with prayer.
routine.simpleDescription.text: Buri izooba otandike kandi ohererukye n'okushaba.

routine.promptText.en: Ave can suggest daily and weekly prayers for you. Save one, change it, or skip it.
routine.promptText.text: Nimbaasa kukutebeekanisiza okushaba buriizooba na buri sande. Kubiika kimwe, okihindure, nari okirekye.

routine.rosaryDescription.en: Morning and night prayers, with the Rosary every day.
routine.rosaryDescription.text: Okushaba omukasheeshe n'ekiro, hamwe na rosari buri izooba.

routine.weeklyDescription.en: The Divine Mercy Chaplet and the Stations of the Cross on Fridays, and the Magnificat for Our Lady on Saturdays.
routine.weeklyDescription.text: Chapleti y'embabazi za Ruhanga hamwe n'okutambura kw'omusharaba aha rwakataano, na Magnificat ya Our Lady aha rwamukaaga.

routine.fullDescription.en: Morning, midday and night prayers and the Rosary every day, with the Divine Mercy Chaplet on Fridays.
routine.fullDescription.text: Okushaba omukasheeshe, omu shaaha z'ekiro n'omu kiro hamwe na Rosary buri izooba, n'okushaba kwa Divine Mercy Chaplet aha rwakataano.

seasons.holyName.en: the Most Holy Name of Jesus

routine.addDescription.en: Choose the days you want to pray this prayer.
routine.addDescription.text: Toorana ebiro ebi orikwenda kushabiramu okushaba oku.

routine.promptShort.en: Get suggested daily and weekly prayers
routine.promptShort.text: Okushaba okurikuteebwaho buri izooba na buri sande

billing.includes.en: Your plan includes every prayer in all three languages, audio, streaks, sharing and reminders.
billing.includes.text: Enteekateeka yaawe erimu buri kushaba omu ndimi zoona ishatu, okuhurikiriza, okuguma nookora, okugabana hamwe n'okwijusya.

billing.signInFirst.en: Create a free account to start your 7-day free trial.
billing.signInFirst.text: Kora akaunti ya busha kutandika okugyezibwa kw'ebiro 7.

billing.trialEnded.en: Your free trial has ended. Choose a plan to keep praying with Ave.
billing.trialEnded.text: Okugyezibwa kwawe okw'obusingye kuhweireho. Toorana enteekateeka kuguma nooshaba na Ave.

billing.methodsUganda.en: Pay with MTN or Airtel mobile money, or a card. Payments are handled securely by PesaPal.
billing.methodsUganda.text: Shashura orikukoresa MTN nainga Airtel mobayiro mane, nari kaadi. Okushashura nikukorwa kurungi PesaPal.

billing.methodsAbroad.en: Pay with Visa or Mastercard. Payments are handled securely by PesaPal.
billing.methodsAbroad.text: Shashura n'ekadi ya Visa nainga Mastercard. Okushashura nikukorwa omu muringo gw'oburinzi kuruga omuri PesaPal.

billing.startFailed.en: Couldn't start the payment. Check your connection and try again.
billing.startFailed.text: Tikabaasa kutandika okushashura. Kyebera okukwatanisa kwawe kandi ogaruke ogyezeho.

billing.notPaidText.en: The payment didn't go through, so nothing was charged. You can try again.
billing.notPaidText.text: Okushashura tikurabiremu, nahabwekyo tihaine ekyashashwirwe. Noobaasa kugaruka ogyezeho.

billing.description.en: Every prayer, in English, Luganda and Runyankore, with audio, streaks, sharing and reminders.
billing.description.text: Buri kushaba, omu Rungyereza, Oruganda hamwe n'Orunyankore, n'obutumwa oburikuhurirwa, okugabana hamwe n'okwijusya.

billing.checkLater.en: We couldn't confirm your payment yet. If money was taken, your plan will be activated shortly. Contact us if it isn't.
billing.checkLater.text: Titurabaasa kuhamya okushashura kwawe. Ku haraabe hariho esente ezatwairwe, enteekateeka yaawe neija kutandika omu bwire butari bwa hare. Twahikaho waaba otarikukimanya.

novena.markWhenDone.en: Tap Mark prayed below when you finish.
novena.markWhenDone.text: Tap Mark akashaba ahansi waawe ku oraahweze.

novena.keepGoing.en: Keep going: you can still finish the novena.

novena.ended.en: This novena's days are over. It comes round again next year.
novena.ended.text: Ebiro bya novena ebi bihoire. Nibigaruka omwaka ogurikukurataho.

reminders.off.en: Get a notification when it's time for each prayer in your routine.
reminders.off.text: Tunga okurabura ku obwire bw'okushaba buri omu nteekateeka yaawe.

reminders.on.en: Reminders are on for this phone. You'll get one at each prayer's time.
reminders.on.text: Okwijutsya kuriho aha simu egi. Noija kutunga kimwe buri bwire bw'okushaba.

reminders.testSent.en: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
reminders.testSent.text: Okukyebera kwohereziibwe. Kishemereire kuhika omu sikonda nkye.

reminders.denied.en: Notifications are blocked for Ave. Allow them in your phone's settings, then come back here.
reminders.denied.text: Okurabura kuzibirwe ahabwa Ave. Kibikirize omu ntebekanisa za esimu yaawe, reero ogaruke aha.

reminders.signIn.en: Sign in to get reminders for your routine.

reminders.testBody.en: Reminders are working. God bless your prayer.
reminders.testBody.text: Okwijutsya kuriyo nikukora. Ruhanga ahe omugisha okushaba kwawe.

reminders.unsupported.en: This browser can't show reminders. Use Chrome on Android, or install Ave on your iPhone.
reminders.unsupported.text: Burausa egi terikubaasa kworeka ebirikwijutsya. Kozesa Chrome aha Android, nainga oteho Ave aha iPhone yaawe.

reminders.installFirst.en: On iPhone, reminders work once Ave is on your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open Ave from there.
reminders.installFirst.text: Aha iPhone, okwijutsya nikukora ku Ave eri aha sikuriini yaawe ey'omuka: kanda Share, reero oyongyere aha sikuriini y'omuka, kandi ogure Ave kuruga aho.

reminders.failed.en: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
reminders.failed.text: Hariho ekintu ekyabaire kigwire. Kyebera okukwatanisa kwawe ogaruke ogyezeho.

splash.accountNote.en: 7 days free, then UGX 7,000 a month in Uganda or USD 3.99 abroad.
splash.accountNote.text: Ebiro 7 bya busha, reero UGX 7,000 buri kwezi omu Uganda nainga USD 3.99 aheeru y'eihanga.

account.deleteFailed.en: Couldn't delete your account. Check your connection and try again.
account.deleteFailed.text: Tikabaasa kushazamu akawunti yaawe. Kyebera okukwatanisa kwawe ogaruke ogyezeho.

account.deleteText.en: This permanently deletes your account, your progress, favourites, prayer routine, reminders and feedback. It can't be undone.
account.deleteText.text: Eki nikishazamu eakaunti yaawe, okutunguuka kwaawe, ebirikukundwa, entebekanisa y'okushaba, okwijutsya hamwe n'okugarukamu. Tikirabasa kugarurwaho.

billing.granted.en: You have free access to Ave from the Ave team.
billing.granted.text: Oine obugabe bw'okuhika ahari Ave kuruga aha tiimu ya Ave.

content-lg.Say 13 Our Father's and 13 Hail Mary's f: Saba Our Father emirundi 13 ne Hail Mary emirundi 13 mu nnaku 13 eziddiriŋŋana.
content-lg.Our Lady Of Guadalupe, mystical rose, ma: Mukama waffe ow'e Guadalupe, omulanga ogw'ekyewuunyo, okwegayirira ku lwa Eklezia Entukuvu; okukuuma Kitaawe Omutukuvu; okuyamba bonna abakusaba mu byetaago byabwe.
content-lg.Since you are the ever Virgin Mary and M: Okuva bw'oli omukazi Omweru Maria era Maama w'Katonda ow'amazima, tuwe okuva eri Omwana wo omutukuvu Yesu ekisa eky'okukuuma okukkiriza kwaffe, essuubi ery'omuwendo mu buzibu obw'obulamu, okwagala okungi, n'ekirabo eky'omuwendo eky'okugumiikiriza. Amiina.
content-lg.Our Lady of Fatima Novena Prayer: Essaala ya Our Lady of Fatima Novena
content-lg.O most gracious Virgin of Guadalupe, in: Omutukuvu Omubereberye ow'e Guadalupe, mu kulabikako kwo ku Lusozi Tepeyac, wasuubiza okulaga obusaasizi n'obulungi eri abo bonna abakwagala era abakwesiga, nga banoonya obuyambi n'obukuumi bwo.
content-lg.Listen to our supplications and grant us: Wulira okusaba kwaffe era otuwa obuwumbi n’okutereeza. Tuli n’essuubi nti, nga twesigama ku buyambi bwo, tewali kintu kisobola kutweraliikiriza oba okutukosa. Nga bw’oba ng’otaddeko amaanyi mu kifaananyi ky’oyagala, kaakati tuwe ebyetaago byaffe. Amiina.
content-lg.Our Lady of the Rosary of Fatima,\nPray:
Mukyala waffe ow'ekikomo e Fatima,
Tusabire.
content-lg.He has shown mercy on those who fear him: Alaze ekisa eri abo bonna abamutya mu buli mulembe.
content-lg.He has shown the strength of his arm,\nh:
Alaze amaanyi g'omukono gwe,
asansudde ab'amalala mu kwebuulirira kwabwe.
content-lg.Most Holy Virgin, who deigned to come to: Omutukuvu Omulongo, eyakkiriza okujja e Fatima, okulaga obugagga bw’ekisa ekisibiddwa mu kusoma Rosary, atusabe omutima ogw’okwagalira ddala okwekkiriza kuno, nga tusaba ku Mysteries of Redemption, tusobole okufuna okukyusa aboonoonyi, okukyusa Russia, n’ebirala byonna bye musaba, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ekitiibwa kyammwe, n’obulungi bw’emyoyo. Amen.
content-lg.He has cast down the mighty from their t:
Asse ab'amaanyi okuva ku ntebe zaabwe,
era ayimusa abaavu.
content-lg.He has filled the hungry with good thing:
Ajjuza abalumwa enjala ebirungi,
n'abagagga abasindika nga tebalina kantu.
content-lg.My soul proclaims the greatness of the L:
Omwoyo gwange gutendereza obukulu bwa Mukama,
omutima gwange gusanyuka mu Katonda omulokozi wange,
kubanga atunuulidde omuweereza we ow’obwetoowaze n’ekisa.
Okuva ku lunaku luno emirembe gyonna girinnyonnyola nga ndi wa mukisa:
Omutonzi Omuyinza yakoze ebintu ebinene ku lwange,
era erinnya lye litukuvu.
content-lg.He has come to the help of his servant I:
Azze okuyamba omuweereza we Isiraeri
kubanga ajjukidde ekisuubizo kye eky'obusaasizi,
ekisuubizo kye yakola bajjajja baffe,
Aburahamu n'abaana be emirembe gyonna.
content-lg.Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is wi: Hail Mary, ojjudde ekisa, Mukama ali naawe. Oweereddwa omukisa mu bakazi bonna, era n'ekibala ky'olubuto lwo, Yesu, kye kirina omukisa. Maria omutukuvu, Maama wa Katonda, tusabire ffe aboonoonyi, kati ne ku ssaawa y'okufa kwaffe. Amen.
content-lg.Our Father, Who art in heaven, hallowed: Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, erinnya lyo litukuzibwe; Obwakabaka bwo bujje; Ebyo by’oyagala bikolebwe ku nsi nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu. Tuwe leero emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku; era otusonyiwe ebyonoono byaffe nga ffe bwe tusonyiwa abatusobya; era otutwale mu kugezesebwa, wabula otuwonye okuva mu bibi. Amiina.
content-lg.Glory be to the Father, and to the Son,: Ekitiibwa kibeere eri Kitaffe, n’eri Omwana, n’eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Nga bwe kyali mu ntandikwa, bwe kiri kaakati, era kijja kubeera bulijjo, ensi etalina kkomo. Amiina.
content-lg.O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us: O Yesu wange, tusonyiwe ebibi byaffe, otuwonye okuva mu muliro gw'omuliro ogw'omu hell, omutwale emyoyo gyonna mu ggulu, naddala abo abali mu bwetaavu obusinga obungi obw'obusaasizi bwo. Amiina.
content-lg.I believe in God, the Father Almighty, C: Nzikiriza mu Katonda, Kitaawe Omuyinza w’ebintu byonna, Omutonzi w’eggulu n’ensi; ne mu Yesu Kristo, Omwana we omu yekka, Mukama waffe, eyazaalibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era n’azaalibwa Namalaaya Maria, n’abonyaabonyezebwa wansi wa Pontiyo Piraato, n’akomererwa ku musaalaba, n’afa, n’aziikibwa. Yagenda mu hell; ku lunaku olwokusatu n’azuukira okuva mu bafu; yalinnya mu ggulu, era atuula ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, Kitaawe Omuyinza w’ebintu byonna; okuva eyo ajja kujja okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango. Nzikiriza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Ekkanisa Enkatolika entukuvu, obumu bw’abatukuvu, okusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi, okuzuukira kw’omubiri, n’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Amiina.
content-lg.Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our l: Hail, Omukyala omutukuvu, Maama w’obusaasizi, obulamu bwaffe, essanyu lyaffe n’essuubi lyaffe! Gwe gwe tukubira, abaana abavuunika ba Eve; gwe gwe tusindika okukaaba kwaffe, nga tukungubaga era nga tukuba amaziga mu kikko kino eky’amaziga. Kyusa amaaso go ag’obusaasizi otutunuulire, era oluvannyuma lw’okugobebwa kuno, tulage ekibala ekirungi ekiva mu lubuto lwo, Yesu. O clement, O mwagalwa, O Virgin Mary omulungi! Tusabire, Maama omutukuvu wa Katonda, tuleme okufuna ebisuubizo bya Kristo. Amen.
content-lg.My God, I believe in you and all that yo: Katonda wange, nzikiriza mu ggwe ne byonna bye wayigiriza kubanga obimbyeera n'ekigambo kyo kituufu.
content-lg.I hope in your promise of Eternal life a: Nsuubira mu kisuubizo kyo eky'obulamu obutaggwaawo era nkusaba okusaasira n'amaanyi go ku lunaku luno.
content-lg.O Jesus, through the Immaculate Heart of: O Yesu, okuyita mu Mutima Omutukuvu gwa Maria, nkutendereza n’okusaba kwange, emirimu gyange, essanyu lyange n’okubonaabona kwange olwaleero, ku lw’ebigendererwa by’Omutima Gwo Omutukuvu, nga nkolera wamu n’Ekirabo ekitukuvu ekya Misa mu nsi yonna, ng’ekyokuddamu eri ebibi, ku lw’ebigendererwa by’abagenyi bange bonna n’abalala, era naddala ku lw’ebigendererwa bya Kitaawe Omutukuvu.
content-lg.Merciful Jesus, I consecrate myself toda: Yesu ow'ekisa, nneewaayo gy'oli leero era bulijjo eri omutima gwo ogutukuvu ennyo.
content-lg.O My God, I love you with my whole heart: O Katonda wange, nkukwatako n'omutima gwange gwonna era okusinga byonna kubanga oli mulungi nnyo era mutuufu; era njagala baliraanwa bange nga bwe njagala nze olw'okukwagala. Nkwegayirira onnyambe nkulekere okukwagala ennyo mu bulamu buno n'obulamu obuliddako emirembe gyonna.
content-lg.Most Sacred Heart of Jesus, I trust in y: Omutima Omutukuvu ennyo ogwa Yesu, nkakasa mu ggwe!
content-lg.Most Sacred Heart of Jesus I implore, th: Omutima Omutukuvu ogwa Yesu nkwegayirira, nnyongere okwagala ennyo.
content-lg.Most Sacred Heart of Jesus, have mercy o: Omutima Omutukuvu ennyo ogwa Yesu, tulage ekisa!
content-lg.Sacred Heart of Jesus, I believe in your: Omutima omutukuvu ogwa Yesu, nzikiriza mu kwagala kwo eri nze.
content-lg.Jesus, meek and humble of heart, make my: Yesu, omuwombeefu era ow'omutima omugonvu, ffeesa omutima gwange okuba ng'ogwo.
content-lg.O My God, I thank you for all the benefi: O Katonda wange, nkwebaza olw'emiganyulo gyonna gye nfuna okuva gyoli leero. Mpa ekitangaala okulaba ebibi bye nnakola, era onnyambe nsonyiwe ddala mu mazima.
content-lg.O my God, because you are so good, I am: O Katonda wange, kubanga oli mulungi nnyo, nsaba nnyo nti nnayonoona gy’oli. N’obuyambi bw’ekisa kyo, ndigenda okugezaako obutaddamu kukola bubi.
content-lg.All praise to you, O God, this night for:
Ekitiibwa kyonna kibeere gy'oli, Ai Katonda, ekiro kino olw'emikisa gy'ekitangaala.
Tukuume, twegayirira, Ai Kabaka w'abakabaka,
Wansi w'amagulu go ag'amaanyi ennyo.
content-lg.Forgive us, Lord, through Christ Your So:
Tusonyiwe, Mukama, okuyita mu Kristo Omwana wo,
Ekibi kyonna kye tukola olunaku luno.
Emirembe gyo gituuse ku nsi, O Mukama,
Tusobole okubeera wamu mu bumu.
content-lg.The Angel of the Lord declared to Mary:\:
Malayika wa Mukama yagamba Malyamu nti:
Era n'afuna olubuto lwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Mwana Maria...
content-lg.Enlighten us, O blessed light,\r\nAnd gi:
Tuyigirize, ggwe ekitangaala ekisanyusa,
Otuleete okuwummula mu kiro kino kyonna.
Otunyweze, olw'ekigendererwa kyo,
Ffenna tusobole okukukolera nga tuvaamu.
content-lg.Behold the handmaid of the Lord:\r\nBe i:
Laba omuweereza wa Mukama:
Kikolebwe gye ndi nga bw'oyogedde. Weebale Mary...
content-lg.And the Word was made flesh:\r\nAnd dwel:
Era Ekigambo kyafuuka omubiri:
N'abeera mu ffe. Hail Mary...
content-lg.Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.\r\nTh:
Tusabire, O Mukama Omukazi omutukuvu wa Katonda.
Tufune obusobozi okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kya Kristo.
content-lg.Divine Mercy Chaplet (3 O'Clock Prayer): Essaala ya Divine Mercy Chaplet (Essaala ey'essaawa 3)
content-lg.Let us pray:\r\nPour forth, we beseech y:
Ka tusabe:
Tusaba, Mukama waffe, otuwe ekisa kyo mu mitima gyaffe, ffe abamanyi okufuuka kwa Kristo, Omwana wo, nga kyategeezebwa mu bubaka bw’omumalaika, tuyitibwe ku kufa kwe n’omusalaba gwe okutuuka ku kitiibwa ky’okuzuukira kwe, okuyita mu Kristo omwami waffe. Amiina.
content-lg.O God, by the resurrection of Your Son,: Ai Katonda, olw’okuzuukira kwa Mwana wo, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, oyagala okusanyusa ensi yonna. Tukusaba otuwe obulamu obutaggwaawo nga tuyita mu Maama we, Omukyala Maria. Kino tukisaba mu Kristo omu oyo Mukama waffe. Amiina.
content-lg.O Blood and Water which gushed forth fro: Omusaayi n'amazzi ebyava mu mutima gwa Yesu ng'ensulo y'ekisa eri ffe, nkakasa nti ggwe njagala!
content-lg.Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal: Katonda omutukuvu, Omuyinza omukulu, Oyo atafa, Tusaasire n'ensi yonna. (Kigambe emirundi esatu) Amiina.
content-lg.Leader: Our Father... All together: Give:
Omukulembeze: Kitaffe... Ffenna awamu: Tuwe ku lunaku luno...
Omukulembeze: Hail Mary... Ffenna awamu: Malyamu omutukuvu...
content-lg.You expired Jesus, but the source of lif: Waweddeko Yesu, naye ensibuko y’obulamu yateekawo obulamu eri emyoyo, era ennyanja y’obusaasizi n’eggulirwa ensi yonna. O Fount of Life, Obusaasizi bwa Katonda obutalina kiggwa, buzinga ensi yonna era weeyanjule ku ffe.
content-lg.(On the ten small beads of each decade)\:
(Ku buli kagwa akatono mu kkumi)
Omukulembeze: Ku lw'okulumwa kw'Omutonzi waffe
Ffenna awamu: Otusaasire n'ensi yonna.
content-lg.(On the large bead before each decade)\r:
(Okusinziira ku kintu ekikulu nga buli mwaka)
Bonna awamu: Kitaffe ow’obulamu obutaggwaawo, nkuleetera omubiri n’omusaayi, emmeeme n’obwakatonda bw’Omwana wo gw’oyagala ennyo, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo okusonyiyibwa ebibi byaffe n’eby’ensi yonna.
content-lg.(Conclude with):\r\nHoly God, Holy Might:
(Ggweko nti):
Katonda omutukuvu, Omuyinza ow’amaanyi, Oyo atafa, Tusaasire ffe n’ensi yonna. (kigambe emirundi esatu) Amiina.
Yesu, Kabaka w’Obusaasizi, nkakasa mu ggwe! (kigambe emirundi esatu)
content-lg.Note: The first line appears twice as it: Weetegereze: Olunyiriri olusooka lulabika emirundi ebiri kubanga luteekeddwa okusomebwa emirundi ebiri.
content-lg.Say 13 Our Father's and 13 Hail Mary's f: Saba Kitaawe waffe emirundi 13 ne Hail Mary emirundi 13 mu nnaku 13 eziddiriŋŋana. Okuba essaala eno, ogigabane n'omuntu omulala era okole Mmisa ey'okwebaza.
content-lg.Our Lady of Guadalupe, mystical rose, ma: Mukama waffe ow'e Guadalupe, omulandira ogw'ekyama, okusabiriza Eklezia Entukuvu; okukuuma Kitaawe Omutukuvu; okuyamba abo bonna abakukoowoola mu byetaago byabwe.
content-lg.All together pray the Creed:\r\nI believ:
Mwenna musabire wamu Creed:
Nzikiriza mu Katonda, Kitaffe omuyinza byonna, omutonzi w’eggulu n’ensi ne mu Yesu Kristo, Omwana we yekka, Mukama waffe, eyazaalibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’azaalibwa Mariya Omugole, n’abonyaabonyezebwa wansi wa Pontius Pilate, n’akomererwa ku musaalaba, n’afa era n’aziikibwa. Yagendera mu hell. Ku lunaku olusatu yazukira okuva mu bafu. Yalinnya mu ggulu era atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, Kitaffe omuyinza byonna. Okuva eyo ajja kujja okulamula abalamu n’abafu. Nzikiriza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Ekkanisa Enkatolika entukuvu, Obumu bw’Abatukuvu, okusonyiyibwa ebibi, okuzuukira kw’omubiri n’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Amiina.
content-lg.Our Lady of the Rosary of Fatima, pray f: Mukama waffe ow'ekisabiro eky'omusala e Fatima, tusabire.
content-lg.He has shown mercy on those who fear him: Alaze ekisa eri abo bonna abamutya mu buli mulembe.
content-lg.O most gracious Virgin of Guadalupe, in: Omutukuvu Virgin wa Guadalupe, mu kulabikako kwo ku lusozi Tepeyac, wateekawo okutegeeza nti ojja kuba n’obusaasizi n’obulungi eri abo bonna abakwagala era abakwesiga nga banoonya obuyambi n’okukuuma kwo. Wuliriza okusaba kwaffe era otuwe obuwanguzi n’okusanyuka. Tulina essuubi nti, nga twesigamye ku buyambi bwo, tewali kintu kyonna kisobola kututabangula oba okutukosa. Nga bw’osigadde naffe mu kifaananyi kyo ekirungi, ka tufune obulungi bwe twetaaga. Amiina.
content-lg.He has shown the strength of his arm,\r\:
Alaze amaanyi g'omukono gwe,
asaasaanyizza ab'amalala mu kwegulumiza kwabwe.
content-lg.My soul proclaims the greatness of the L:
Omwoyo gwange gutendereza obukulu bwa Mukama,
omutima gwange gusanyuka mu Katonda, omulokozi wange,
kubanga atunuulidde omuweereza we ow’obwetoowaze n’ekisa.
Okuva ku lunaku luno emirembe gyonna girinnyonnyola nga ndi wa mukisa:
Omutonzi Omuyinza byonna ankoleddewo ebikulu,
era erinnya lye litukuvu.
content-lg.Most Holy Virgin, who deigned to come to: Omukyala Omutukuvu, eyakkiriza okujja e Fatima okulaga obugagga bw’ekisa ekisirikiddwa mu kusoma Rosary, atuteemu amaanyi n’okwagala okwenkanya ku kweyongera kw’okusaba kuno, nga okusoma ku byama by’Okununulibwa kwaffe bwe kutuyamba okufuna okukyusa aboonoonyi, okukyusa Russia, era (wano yogerako ebirala by’osabira) bye tusaba gy’oli mu Novena eno, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, olw’ekitiibwa kyo, n’olw’obulungi bw’emyoyo. Amiina.
content-lg.He has cast down the mighty from their t:
Agobye ab'amaanyi ku ntebe zaabwe,
n'agulumiza abaavu.
content-lg.He has filled the hungry with good thing:
Yajjuza abalumwa enjala ebirungi,
era omugagga yamuwummuza nga talina kintu.
content-lg.He has come to the help of his servant I:
Azze okuyamba omuddu we Isirayiri
kubanga ajjukidde ekisuubizo kye eky’obusaasizi,
ekisuubizo kye yakola bajjajja baffe,
eri Ibulayimu n’abaana be emirembe gyonna.

Mukama, onyweze ekisa. Mukama, onyweze ekisa.
Kristo, onyweze ekisa. Kristo, onyweze ekisa.
Mukama, onyweze ekisa. Mukama, onyweze ekisa.
Kristo, tuwulire. Kristo, tuwulire mu kisa.
content-lg.God the Father of Heaven, have mercy on:
Katonda Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu, twasaasire.
Katonda Omwana, Omununuzi w'ensi, twasaasire.
Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu, twasaasire.
Tiriniti Entukuvu, Katonda omu, twasaasire.
content-lg.Virgin most prudent, pray for us.\r\nVir:
Mbeerera asinga obukugu, tusabire.
Mbeerera asinga okuweebwa ekitiibwa, tusabire.
Mbeerera asinga okumanyibwa, tusabire.
Mbeerera asinga amaanyi, tusabire.
Mbeerera asinga ekisa, tusabire.
Mbeerera asinga obwesigwa, tusabire.

Maama wa Katonda omutukuvu, tusabire.
Omukyala omulongoosa omutukuvu, tusabire.
Maama wa Kristo, tusabire.
Maama w'Ekkanisa, tusabire.
Maama w'ekisa kya Katonda, tusabire.

Maama asinga okwagalwa, tusabire.

Maama w'amagezi amalungi, tusabire.
Maama w'Omutonzi waffe, tusabire.
Maama w'Omulokozi waffe, tusabire.
content-lg.Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of:
Omwana gw'endiga owa Katonda, atwala ebibi by'ensi, otusonyiwe, Mukama waffe.
Omwana gw'endiga owa Katonda, atwala ebibi by'ensi, owulire okusaba kwaffe mu kisa, Mukama waffe.
Omwana gw'endiga owa Katonda, atwala ebibi by'ensi, twasaasira.
content-lg.Queen of Angels, pray for us.\r\nQueen o:
Kwiini w'Abamalayika, tusabire.
Kwiini w'Abakulembeze b'Eddiini, tusabire.
Kwiini w'Abalaguzi, tusabire.
Kwiini w'Abatume, tusabire.

Kwiini w'Abakkiriza, tusabire.

Kwiini w'Abatuukirivu bonna, tusabire.

content-lg.Mirror of justice, pray for us.\r\nSeat:
Ekirabo ky'obwenkanya, tusabire.
Ekifo eky'amagezi, tusabire.
Ensibuko y'essanyu lyaffe, tusabire.
Ekyuma ky'eby'omwoyo, tusabire.

Ekyuma ekimu eky'okwewaayo, tusabire.

Ekifo ky'abasajja aboonoonyi, tusabire.

Obuyambi bw'Abakristaayo, tusabire.
content-lg.Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God.\r\nTh:
Tusabire, O Maama omutukuvu wa Katonda.
Tuyambe okufuna ebyo Kristo bye yasuubiza.
content-lg.Let us pray:\r\nGrant, we beseech you, O:
Ka tusabe:
Tuwe, tukusaba, O Mukama Katonda, nti abaweereza bo basobole okufuna obulamu obutaggwaawo mu birowoozo n’omubiri; era nga tuyita mu kusabira kwa Mary eyatukuzibwa, omuwala atalina musango, tusobole okuva mu nnaku eziriwo kati, era tufune essanyu ery’olubeerera. Mu Kristo Mukama waffe. Amiina.
content-lg.\"The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not w: "Mukama ye musumba wange; sirina kye nneetaaga. Anzisa mu kisibo ekirungi."
content-lg.Simon is compelled to help, reminding us: Simon ayambiddwa okuyamba, ng'atujjukiza buli omu okutwala obuzito bwa munne.
content-lg.Near Calvary, Jesus falls once more, yet: Okumpi ne Kalivaali, Yesu agwa omulundi omulala naye okwagala kwe tekuggya.
content-lg.Weakened by suffering, Jesus falls, yet: Bwe yali ng'akooye olw'okubonaabona, Yesu yagwa wansi naye n'ayimuka okutambulira awamu naffe.
content-lg.The nails pierce His hands and feet, dri: Enjala zisala mu mikono gye ne mu bigere bye, nga zikubiddwa ebibi byaffe era nga zinywezeddwa okwagala kwe.
content-lg.Mary receives the body of her Son: a mot: Mary afuna omulambo gw'Omwana we: ennaku ya maama eteekwa okuba nga yali nnene nnyo.
content-lg.Jesus and His 12 Apostles. Pray for 13 c: Yesu n'Abatume be 12. Musabe okumala ennaku 13 eziddiriŋŋana
content-lg.Jesus and His 12 Apostles, over 13 conse: Yesu n'Abatume be 12, mu nnaku ezisukka mu 13 ezeegattira awamu
content-lg.The Three O'clock Prayer, prayed on ordi: Essaala ey'essaawa ssatu, esabibwa ku bikomo bya rosari ebya bulijjo.
content-lg.On the Large Bead Before Each Decade: Ku Kkubo Ekkulu nga Buli Mwaka Gw'ekumi Gutandika
content-lg.On the Ten Small Beads of Each Decade: Ku Beedi Ekkumi Entono ez'Obukadde Bwonna
content-lg.Pray these prayers once a day for 9 days: Saba essaala zino omulundi gumu buli lunaku okumala ennaku 9
content-lg.You expired Jesus,\nBut the source of li:
Waweddeko Yesu,
Naye ensibuko y’obulamu yasanyuka eri emyoyo,
n’ennyanja y’ekisa n’egulawo eri ensi yonna.
O Fount of Life, ekisa kya Katonda ekitasobola kukomekkerezebwa,
kubikka ensi yonna era weefumite ku ffe.
content-lg.Pray the same prayers each day, for 9 da: Saba essaala ze zimu buli lunaku, okumala ennaku 9 eziddiriŋŋana.
content-lg.I believe in God, the Father almighty, t:
Nzikiriza mu Katonda, Kitaffe omuyinza w’ebintu byonna, eyatonda eggulu n’ensi
ne mu Yesu Kristo, Omwana we yekka, Mukama waffe, eyazaalibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
eyazaalibwa mu Malyamu Omugole, n’abonaabona wansi wa Pontiyo Piraato, n’akomererwa ku musaalaba, n’afa era n’aziikibwa.
Yagenda mu hell. Ku lunaku olwokusatu yazukira okuva mu bafu.
Yalinnya mu ggulu era atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, Kitaffe omuyinza w’ebintu byonna.
Okuva awo ajja kujja okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango.
Nzikiriza mu Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Ekkanisa Enkatolika entukuvu, Obumu bw’Abatukuvu,
okuggibwa ebibi, okuzuukira kw’omubiri n’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Amiina.
content-lg.Pray for me, as I feel helpless and alon: Nsabira, kubanga mpulira nga sirina buyambi era ndi nzekka.
content-lg.In the Name of the Father, and of the So: Mu linnya lya Kitaffe, n'ery'Omwana, n'ery'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Amiina.
content-lg.Most holy Apostle, St. Jude, faithful se: Omutume omutukuvu, St. Jude, omuweereza omwesigwa era mukwano gwa Yesu, Ekkanisa ekussaamu ekitiibwa n'okukusaba mu nsi yonna ng'omuwabuzi w'embeera enzibu, eziba ziweddeko essuubi.
content-lg.Intercede with God for me that He bring: Nkwatira ku Katonda ansabireko asobole okuleeta obuyambi obulabika era obwangu mu kiseera nga obuyambi buli kumpi okuggwaamu essuubi. Jjangu onnyambe mu bwetaavu buno obunene nsobole okufuna okubudaabudibwa n’obuyambi okuva mu ggulu mu byonna bye nneetaaga, ebizibu n’okubonaabona kwange, ddala:
content-lg.and that I may praise God with you and a: Era nti nsobole okutendereza Katonda wamu nammwe n’abatukuvu bonna emirembe gyonna. Nsuubiza, Omutukuvu St. Jude Omugulumiziddwa, okubeera nga ntegeera bulijjo ekisa kino ekinene kye nnaweebwa Katonda era n’okukuwa ekitiibwa ng’omukulembeze wange ow’enjawulo era ow’amaanyi, era okusaba abantu okukwegattako mu bwesigwa.
content-lg.May the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus be ad: Omutima gwa Yesu ogusinga obutukuvu guweebwe ekitiibwa era gwagalibwe mu masabo gonna okutuusa ku nkomerero y'ensi. Amiina.
content-lg.May the most Sacred Heart of Jesus be pr: Omutima gwa Yesu ogutukuvu ennyo gutenderezebwe era guweebwe ekitiibwa kati ne mu biseera byonna. Amiina.
content-lg.St. Jude pray for me and hear my prayers: St. Jude ansabire era awulire okusaba kwange. Amiina.
Omutima gwa Maliyamu ogutalina kamogo gutenderezebwe.
content-lg.Blessed be St. Jude Thaddeus, in all the: Atenderezebwe St. Jude Thaddeus, mu nsi yonna ne mu biseera byonna eby'olubeerera.
content-lg.Novena to Pope St. Leo the Great: Okusaba kwa Novena eri Paapa St. Leo the Great
content-lg.Prayer to Pope St. Leo the Great: Okusaba eri Paapa St. Leo ow'amaanyi
content-lg.Glory be to thee, O Jesus, Lion of the T: Ekitiibwa kibeere gy'oli, O Yesu, Empologoma y'Ekika ky'Abayudaaya! eyagulumiza mu Kkanisa yo Empologoma okugikuuma mu biseera ebyo ebizibu, nga Okukkiriza okutukuvu kwali mu bulabe obusinga.
content-lg.The Incarnate Word is blasphemed in thes: Ekigambo ekifukiriddwa kiyisibwaamu obuvvoozi mu biseera byaffe bino; okuwoolera ekitiibwa kye, nga otusindikira abantu ab'obunyiikivu n'okumanya.
content-lg.O holy Pontiff Leo! thou worthily repres: Omutukuvu Pontiff Leo! wakyoleka bulungi Peter mu kifo kye, era okuyigiriza kwo okw’obusumba tekwalekera awo kukulukuta, nga kwali kwa mazima n’obugumu obulungi. Ekkanisa ey’omulembe gwo yakussaamu ekitiibwa ng’Omuyigiriza omukulu ow’Okukkiriza; ate ekkanisa eziddako zonna zakumanyiira ng’omu ku basomesa abamanyi ennyo n’ababuulizi b’Ekigambo kya Katonda.
content-lg.Thou charged Peter with confirming his B: Ow’ekitiibwa Peter yategeezeddwa okukakasa ab’oluganda be (St. Luke, xxii. 32); era tulabye Leo, mu ye Peter yabeeramu, ng’atuukiriza omulimu guno n’obuyinza obw’enkizo. Tuwulidde okusiima kw’Olukiiko olutukuvu, olwasanyuka olw’okuyigiriza kwa Leo okuva mu ggulu, ne lutegeeza ekisa eky’amaanyi kye wawa ku kisibo kyo, bwe walagira Peter okuliisa endiga n’abaana b’endiga.
content-lg.From thy throne in heaven, where now tho: Okuva ku ntebe yo ey’obwakabaka mu ggulu, gy’oli kati ng’ofuga, tuwe obumanyirivu bw’ekyama ekikulu ky’oyitibwa okukuuma. Wansi w’ekiwandiiko kyo eky’omwoyo, ekyaama kino kyeyongera okutegeerekeka; tulaba engeri gye kikwatagana bulungi n’ebintu ebirala byonna ebyama; era Okukkiriza kusanyuka olw’okufuna okulaba okumpi ku kigendererwa kya Katonda kye tukkirizaamu. Oba! Tugumye Okukkiriza kuno mu ffe.
content-lg.Thou triumphed over barbarian invaders:: Wawangula abalumbaganyi abatamanyi: Attila yakkiriza obukulu bw'obutukuvu bwo n'okwogera kwo, ng'akomyawo amagye ge okuva mu ttaka ly'Abakristaayo lye baali balumbye.
content-lg.In these our days, there have risen up n: Mu nnaku zino, waliwo abantu abapya abatalina mpisa, abakola ebintu eby’obulungi naye nga bakyali ba kitalo, abasobola okutukubiriza nti eddiini eteekwa okuggibwa mu by’enjigiriza, era nti Gavumenti mu mateeka gaayo ne mu bitongole byayo, eteekwa okuleka okussaamu ekitiibwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Kabaka eyaweebwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu n’ensi (St. Matth. xxviii. 18).
content-lg.Oh! help us by thy powerful intercession: Oo! tuyambe n'obuyinza bwo obw'okusaba, kubanga akabi kaffe kali waggulu nnyo. Bangi basikiriziddwa era bakyuse okuva mu mazima nga beekulisa nti bakyali Bakristaayo.
content-lg.Pray that the light, that is left within: Saba nti omusana oguli mu ffe teguzikizibwa, era nti obulimba bw’abantu abangi obuliwo kati bukomewo. Attila yali mukkiriza wa bannansi; abakulembeze baffe ab’omulembe guno ne Gavumenti zaffe beeyita Bakristayo: babalabirire, mubafunire omusana okulaba ekifo ekibi gye batwala abantu.
content-lg.These days of Paschal Time must remind t: Ennaku zino ez’Obudde bwa Paschal zirina okukujjukiza, O Pontiff omutukuvu! ku Easter gyewakolako emabega wano ku nsi, nga weebaseemu abayigirizwa abapya, ng’obawa obulamu mu bigambo byo eby’amaanyi: saba olw’Abakkiriza abali mu Easter eno, abazzeemu obulamu obupya ne Kristo.
content-lg.Bless, O Leo! and help the Pontiff who i: Bless, O Leo! era oyambe Pontiff eyali akuliddemu ku ntebe ya Peter. Laga okwagala kwo eri Rome, eyalina ebyafaayo eby'obutukuvu n'ebikadde ebyayogerwako mu bigambo byo eby'amaanyi n'eby'eggulu.
content-lg.We also ask, St Leo, that you pray for u: Era tusaba, St Leo, otusabire mu kigendererwa kyaffe (yogera okusaba kwaffe wano…)
content-lg.What they most stand in need of is, a fu: Kye basinga okwetaaga kwe kumanya obulungi n’okutegeera omuwendo gwabwe Omulokozi, basobole okumwegattako ennyo era bawereze mu buweereza bwe obutukuvu. Okusaba kwo kwe kuba kuyamba okubawa okumanya kuno; okusaba kwo, olina okubayigiriza ky’ali mu mbeera ye eya Katonda n’ey’omuntu: nga Katonda, Ye ye Nkomerero yaabwe, era Omutongole waabwe oluvannyuma lw’okufa; nga Muntu, Muganda waabwe, Omulokozi waabwe, n’ekyokulabirako kyabwe.
content-lg.Novena to Our Lady of Guadalupe: Novena eri Mukama waffe ow'e Guadalupe
content-lg.Mother of the Americas, who promised to: Maama w'amawanga ga Amerika, eyasuubiza okuwulira essaala zaffe
content-lg.The Name above all names, from Christmas: Erinnya erisinga amannya gonna, okuva ku Ssekukkulu okutuuka ku mbaga yaayo
content-lg.Novena to the Holy Name of Jesus: Okusaba okw'ennaku kkumi n'emwe eri erinnya lya Yesu Eritukuvu
content-lg.Novena to Our Lady of Hope: Okusaba kwa Novena eri Mukama waffe ow'Essuubi
content-lg.Mother of holy hope, for those weighed d: Maama w'essuubi ery'ekitiibwa, eri abo abazitoowereddwa okutya
content-lg.Novena for Fertility to Conceive a Baby: Okusaba okw'ennaku kkumi n'emu ku kufuna olubuto
content-lg.With Our Lady, St. Gerard, Sts. Joachim: N'omukyala waffe, St. Gerard, Sts. Joachim ne Anne, St. Colette ne St. Raphael
content-lg.From Good Friday to the Saturday before: Okuva ku Good Friday okutuuka ku Lwomukaaga nga olunaku lwa Divine Mercy Sunday terunnatuuka
content-lg.Pray these prayers each day, for 9 days: Saba essaala zino buli lunaku okumala ennaku 9 eziddiring'ana, oluvannyuma ogoberere Chapleti ya Divine Mercy.
content-lg.“Today bring to Me all mankind, especial: “Leero ntegeeza abantu bonna, naddala aboonoonyi bonna, era mubateekemu mu nnyanja y’obusaasizi bwange. Mu ngeri eno mujja kunyamba okunzizaamu amaanyi mu bulumi obw’amaanyi obuva ku kufiirwa emyoyo.”
content-lg.Pray the Divine Mercy Chaplet. You can u: Saba Chaplet ya Divine Mercy. Osobola okukozesa obusale obwa bulijjo obwa Rosary.
content-lg.Eternal Father, turn Your merciful gaze: Kitaffe ow’obulamu obutaggwaawo, kyusa amaaso go ag’ekisa ku bantu bonna naddala aboonoonyi abavu, bonna nga bali mu mutima gwa Yesu ogw’ekisa ennyo. Ku lw’okubonaabona kwe okulungi, tuwe ekisa kyo, tusobole okutendereza obuyinza bw’ekisa kyo emirembe gyonna. Amiina.
content-lg.Most Merciful Jesus, whose very nature i: Yesu Omusaasizi Ennyo, ow’obulungi obutaggwaawo era asonyiwa ffe, tolabira ku bibi byaffe naye olaba ku bwesige bwe twateeka mu bulungi bwo obutaggwaawo. Tufunire ffenna mu maka g’Omutima Gwo ogw’Obusaasizi Ennyo, era totuleka kugivaamu. Tukusaba kino mu kwagala kwo okutukwataganya ne Kitaffe n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.
content-lg.3. On the first beads above the crucifix: 3. Ku mpeke ezisooka waggulu wa crucifix, saba Our Father omu, Hail Mary omu n'okukkiriza kw'Abatume.
content-lg.6. Repeat steps 4 and 5 for all five dec: 6. Ddamu emitendera 4 ne 5 ku buli myaka ataano gyonna.
content-lg.5. On each of the ten Hail Mary beads, s: 5. Ku buli kamu ku buwero ekkumi obwa Hail Mary, yogera nti: Olw'okulumwa kwe okungi, tulage ekisa ffe n'ensi yonna.
content-lg.4. On each Our Father bead, say: Eternal: 4. Ku buli kintu ekikozesebwa mu kusaba, ogamba nti: Kitaffe ow’Obulamu obutaggwawo, nkuleetera Omubiri n’Omusaayi, Obulamu n’Obwakatonda bw’Omwana wo omwagalwa ennyo, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, okusonyiyira ebibi byaffe n’eby’ensi yonna.
content-lg.7. Conclude with the Holy God prayer, th: 7. Okomekkereza n'okusaba kwa Katonda Omutukuvu, emirundi esatu: Katonda Omutukuvu, Omuyinza Omutukuvu, Atafa Omutukuvu, otusaasire awamu n'ensi yonna.
content-lg.St. Faustina’s Prayer for Sinners: Okusaba kwa St. Faustina eri Aboonoonyi
content-lg.O Blood and Water, which gushed forth fr: O Musayi n'amazzi, ebyava mu mutima gwa Yesu ng'ensulo y'ekisa gyetuli, nkukkiririzaamu! (emirundi esatu)
content-lg.You expired, Jesus, but the source of li: Waweddeko, Yesu, naye ensibuko y’obulamu yasanyuka eri emyoyo, era ennyanja y’ekisa ky’okusaasira n’egulebwa eri ensi yonna. O Fount of Life, ekisa kya Katonda ekitasobola kukomekkerezebwa, gubikke ensi yonna era weefumbe ku ffe.
content-lg.I believe in the Holy Spirit,\nthe holy:
Nzikiriza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu,
Ekkanisa entukuvu ey'Abakatuliki,
Obumu bw'abatukuvu,
Okusonyiyibwa ebibi,
Okuzuukira kw'omubiri,
n'obulamu obutaggwawo.
content-lg.Eternal God, in whom mercy is endless an: Katonda ow’obulamu obutaggwaawo, mu ye ekisa kye tekiggwaawo era n’ekitabo ky’obusaasizi, ekitaggwaawo, tulabirire bulungi era oyongere ku kisa kyo mu ffe, tusobole okuba nga mu biseera ebizibu tetwewala oba okuggwaamu essuubi, wabula nga twesiga nnyo okukola by’oyagala eby’obutukuvu, eby’okwagala n’Obusaasizi bwennyini.
content-lg.Prayer to Our Lady of Guadalupe: Okusaba eri Mukyala Waffe ow'e Guadalupe
content-lg.You promised to hear our supplications,: Watusuubiza okuwulira okusaba kwaffe, okukaza amaziga gaffe, n'okutubudaabuda n'okutuwa obuweerero.
content-lg.O Jesus, eternal Truth, our Life, I call: O Yesu, Amazima agataggwaawo, Obulamu bwaffe, nkuyita era nsaba ekisa kyo eri aboonoonyi abavu. Omutima ogw’amaanyi ogwa Mukama wange, ogujjudde obusaasizi n’ekisa ekitagambika, nkusaba okubaako ky’okolera aboonoonyi abavu. Omutima Ogutukuvu ennyo, Ensibuko y’Ekisa mwe muva ebikadde by’obulungi obutayinza kukkirizika ku bantu bonna, nsaba okufuna omusana gw’okubalabirira. O Yesu, jjukira Okufa kwo okw’obulumi era tokkiriza kufiirwa baamala okununulwa ku bbeeyi ey’omuwendo ogw’Omusaayi gwo ogw’omuwendo ennyo. O Yesu, bwe ndowooza ku bbeeyi ey’amaanyi ey’Omusaayi gwo, nsanyuka olw’obunene bwakyo, kubanga akatono akamu kokka kaali kamala okulokola aboonoonyi bonna. Newankubadde ekibi kye kisibo ky’obubi n’obutakkiriza, omuwendo ogusasuliddwa ku lwaffe tegusobola kugeraageranyizibwa. Noolwekyo, buli muntu akkirize mu Kufa kwa Mukama, era ateekewo essuubi lye mu kisa kye. Katonda tajja kwegaana kisa kye eri muntu yenna. Eggulu n’ensi bisobola okukyuka, naye ekisa kya Katonda tekisobola kuggwaawo. Oh, ssanyu ki ery’amaanyi eriri mu mutima gwange nga ndowooza ku bulungi bwo obutayinza kukkirizika, O Yesu! Njagala okuleeta aboonoonyi bonna ku bigere byo basobole okugulumiza ekisa kyo mu myaka egitaggwaawo (Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska, 72).
content-lg.Remember, O most gracious Virgin of Guad: Jjukira, O Mweru Omulungi ennyo ow’e Guadalupe, nti mu kweyoleka kwo okw’omu ggulu ku lusozi Tepeyac, wasuubiza okulaga obusaasizi n’obutabangula eri abo bonna abakwagala era abakwesiga nga banoonya obuyambi bwo n’okukusaba mu byetaago ne mu buzibu bwabwe.
content-lg.Never has it been known that anyone who: Tekyali kumanyiddwa nti omuntu yenna eyaddukira mu bukuumi bwo, yasaba obuyambi bwo, oba okusaba okuwuliriza kwo, yalekebwa nga talina buyambi. Nga tukubirizibwa obwesige buno, tukujjira gyoli, O Mary, Maama Omweru ow’Omukama omutuufu!
content-lg.O Greatly Merciful God, Infinite Goodnes: Katonda Omusaasizi Ennyo, Obulungi obutaggwaawo, leero abantu bonna bakaaba okuva mu kizikiza ky’obuzibu bwabwe nga basaba ekisa kyo n’okusaasira kwo, Katonda; era bakuba okuva mu ddoboozi lyabwe ery’amaanyi ery’obuzibu. Katonda ow’ekisa, togaana kusaba kw’abagoberezi b’ensi eno! O Mukama, Obulungi obusukka ku kutegeera kwaffe, Oyo amanyi obuzibu bwaffe buli kimu, era amanyi nti mu maanyi gaffe tetusobola kukulinnyaako, tukusaba: tuwe ekisa kyo era weeyongere okwongera ekisa kyo mu ffe, tusobole okukola by’oyagala eby’obutukuvu mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna ne mu kiseera ky’okufa. Leka amaanyi ag’ekisa kyo gatukuume okuva mu mivuyo gy’abalabe b’obulokozi bwaffe, tusobole okubeera n’obwesige ng’abaana bo, okulindirira okujja kwa [Omwana wo] okusembayo, olunaku olumanyiddwa ggwe wekka. Era tusuubira okufuna byonna bye twasuubizibwa Yesu newankubadde obuzibu bwaffe bwonna. Kubanga Yesu ye ssuubi lyaffe: mu mutima gwe ogw’ekisa, nga tuyita mu luggi olugazi, tuyingira mu ggulu (Diary, 1570).
content-lg.O Holy Mother of God, despise not our pe: O Mukama Katonda, togaana kusaba kwaffe, naye mu kisa kyo tuwulire era otuddemu. Amiina.
content-lg.Placing ourselves beneath your maternal: Bwe tweteeka wansi w'okutunuulirwa kwo, era nga tukusaba mu byetaago byaffe byonna, tetwetaaga kukola kintu kirala kyonna.
content-lg.O Virgin of Guadalupe, you want to remai: O Virgin wa Guadalupe, oyagala okusigala naffe ng'oyita mu kifaananyi kyo ekirungi ennyo, ggwe omukazi waffe, obulamu bwaffe era obulamu bwaffe.
content-lg.Though grieving under the weight of our: Wadde nga tukyali mu bulumi olw’ebibi byaffe, tujja okukusinziza. Tukakasa nti nga tuli wansi w’ekisiikirize kyo n’obukuumi bwo, tewali kintu kyonna kijja kutulumya oba okutubonereza, era tetulina kutya bulwadde oba obuzibu bwonna, oba ennaku endala yonna.
content-lg.Dearest Lady of Guadalupe, fruitful Moth: Mukyala omwagalwa owa Guadalupe, Maama ow'obutukuvu era omuzadde w'ebibala, njigiriza engeri zo ez'obuwombeefu n'amaanyi. Wulira okusaba kwange okw'obuwombeefu okuweereddwa n'obwesige obuva mu mutima okusaba ekisa kino.
content-lg.O merciful Jesus! Who didst in Thine ear: Yesu omusaasizi! Ani eyatandika okukola emirimu gyo ng’omuwonyi mu buto bwo, ng’afuka omusaayi gwo ogw’omuwendo era n’atuwa erinnya eryo erisinga amannya gonna; tukwebaza olw’obujulizi obwo obw’okwagala kwo okutaggwaawo.
content-lg.Come, then, into the midst of us, most a: Jjangu, kati mu makkati gaffe, Yesu omwagalwa ennyo!
content-lg.We venerate Thy sacred Name, in union wi: Tukwasa erinnya lyo ettukuvu, mu kwegatta n'okussa ekitiibwa ku malayika eyasooka okulirangirira ku nsi, era tukwataganya okwagala kwaffe n'obwesigwa obulungi obw'erinnya lya Yesu ery'ekitiibwa mu biseera byonna nga bw'ateeka mu mitima gy'abaweereza bo.
content-lg.For it is in Thy Sacred Name we are here: Kubanga mu linnya lyo ettukuvu mwe twakuŋŋaanira.
content-lg.Animated with a firm faith in Thine uner: Nga tukkiriza nnyo ekigambo kyo ekituufu, era nga twesiga obusaasizi bwo, kati tukusaba mu buwombeefu okujjukira ekisuubizo ky’oyogeddeko nti singa abantu babiri oba basatu bakuŋŋaanira mu linnya lyo, ggwe mwennyini ojja kubeera wakati waabwe.
content-lg.V. Lord, have mercy on us.\nR. Christ, h:
V. Mukama, tulaga ekisa.
R. Kristo, tulaga ekisa.
content-lg.O Blessed Mother of our Redeemer; who di: O Mukama Omukazi Omutukuvu ow’Omulezi waffe; eyakola nnyo mu kubonaabona kwa Mwana wo omwagalwa, bwe yamala okufuka omusaayi gwe omutukuvu, era n’atutwalira erinnya lya Yesu; otusabireko mu linnya eryo erisanyusa, tusobole okufuna obulungi bwe tusaba mu Novena eno.
content-lg.Come into our hearts, that Thy Holy Spir: Jjangu mu mitima gyaffe, Omwoyo Wo Omutukuvu asabe mu ffe era ku lwaffe; era otuwa ekisa okuyita mu linnya eryo ery'ekitiibwa, eriri essanyu ly'eggulu, obutya bw'omuliro ogw'omu hell, okubudaabudibwa kw'abo abali mu bulumi, n'obusobozi obunywevu obw'okwesiga kwaffe okutalina kkomo, ebisaba byonna bye tukola mu Novena eno.
content-lg.Beg, also, that the most ardent love may: Era tusaba nti okwagala okw’amaanyi kuteeke erinnya eryo ettukuvu mu mitima gyaffe, lubeere mu birowoozo byaffe bulijjo, era ku mimwa gyaffe emirundi mingi; lubeere obukuumi bwaffe mu kukemebwa, n’obuddukiro bwaffe mu kabi, mu bulamu bwaffe, era lubeere okubudaabuda n’okuyamba mu kiseera ky’okufa.
content-lg.V. God the Father of Heaven,\nR. Have me:
V. Katonda Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu,
R. Otusaasire.
content-lg.V. God the Son, Redeemer of the world,\n:
V. Katonda Omwana, Omununula w'ensi,
R. Otusaasire.
content-lg.V. Lord, have mercy on us. Jesus, hear u:
V. Mukama, twasaasire. Yesu, tuwulirize.
R. Yesu, mu kisa otuwulirize.
content-lg.V. God the Holy Spirit,\nR. Have mercy o:
V. Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
R. Otusaasire.
content-lg.V. Holy Trinity, one God,\nR. Have mercy:
V. Obusatu obutukuvu, Katonda omu,
R. Tusaasire.
content-lg.V. Jesus, Son of the living God,\nR. Hav:
V. Yesu, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu,
R. Otusaasire.
content-lg.After each line, answer: have mercy on u: Buli luvannyuma lw'olunyiriri, yogerako nti: tusaasire.
content-lg.V. From all evil,\nR. deliver us, O Jesu:
V. Okuva mu bubi bwonna,
R. otuwonye, O Yesu.
V. Beera musaasizi,
R. Otusonyiwe, O Yesu.
content-lg.V. Be merciful,\nR. graciously hear us,:

content-lg.After each line, answer: deliver us, O J: Buli lwaanyuma lw'olunyiriri, zzaamu: otuleete, O Yesu.

content-lg.O Lord Jesus Christ, Thou hast said, Ask: Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, wagamba nti, Saba muliweebwa, noonya mulizuula, konkona muliggulirwawo.
content-lg.Grant, we beg Thee, to us who ask it, th: Grant, tukusaba ggwe, ffe abasaba ekirabo ky'okwagala kwo okutukuvu ennyo, tusobole okukwagala n'omutima gwaffe gwonna mu bigambo ne mu bikolwa, era tetulekera awo kukutendereza.
content-lg.From all sin.\nFrom Your wrath.\nFrom th:
Okuva mu kibi kyonna.
Okuva mu busungu bwo.
Okuva mu mitego gya dayimooni.
Okuva mu mwoyo gw’obwenzi.
Okuva mu kufa okutaggwaawo.

Mu kubonaabona kwo.
Mu kufa kwo n’okuziikibwa kwo.
Mu kuzuukira kwo.
Mu kukyusibwa kwo okugenda mu ggulu.
Mu kutandika kw’Ekirabo Ekisinga Obutukuvu Eky’Emmere Enjereere.
Mu ssanyu lyo.
Mu kitiibwa kyo.
content-lg.Give us, O Lord, as much a lasting fear: Tuwe, O Mukama, okutya okw’obulamu obutaggwaawo nga bwe kuli okwagala okw’obulamu obutaggwaawo eri Erinnya Lyo Eritukuvu, kubanga Ggwe, omutuufu era Kabaka ow’emirembe gyonna, tolemererwa kulabirira abo b’otadde mu kwagala kwo.
content-lg.O Blessed Virgin Mary,\nMother of Grace,:
O Mbeerera Omukama Maria,
Maama w'ekisa, essuubi ly'ensi.
Tuwulire, abaana bo abakukaabira.
content-lg.I am the mother of fair love, and of fea:
Nze nze maama w’okwagala okutukuvu, era ow’entiisa,
era ow’amagezi, era ow’essuubi ettukuvu.
Mu nze mulimu ekisa kyonna eky’ekkubo n’amazima;
mu nze mulimu essuubi lyonna ery’obulamu n’obulungi.
Jjangu gyendi bonna abankwana
mujjuzibwe ebibala byange (Sirach 24:24-26).
content-lg.Jesus, splendor of the Father.\nJesus, b:

Yesu, omusana gw'ekitangaala eky'enkomeredde.

Yesu, obutukuvu bw'Abawala Abembeerera.
Yesu, engule y'Abatukuvu.
content-lg.O God, who by the marvelous protection\n:
Ai Katonda, eyayita mu bukuumi obw’ekitalo
bw’omukyala omutukuvu Maria
n’atunyweza mu ssuubi,
twakusaba otuyambe,
nga tuyimirira mu kusaba nga tumugoberera,
tufune ebyo bye tusaba n’obwesigwa.
Mu Kristo Mukama waffe.
content-lg.O Mary, my Mother,\nI kneel before you w:
O Mary, Maama wange,
Nkwatira mu maaso go n’omutima oguzito.
Obuzibu bw’ebibi byange bunyigiriza.
Okumanya obunafu bwange kunnyiga amaanyi.
Ndi mu kutya n’okukemebwa okw’enjawulo zonna.
Naye ndi mu kwagala ebintu eby’ensi eno

content-lg.O Mother of Mercy,\nhave pity on me in m:
O Maama w’Obulungi,
nkusaasire mu buzibu bwange.
Oli wa maanyi gonna n’Omwana wo ow’obwakatonda.
Tayinza kugaana kusaba kwonna okuva ku mutima gwo ogutukuvu.
Nnyonnyola nga Maama ow’amazima gyendi
ng’oba omuwolereza wange mu maaso g’entebe ye.
O Kifo ky’Abonoonyi
n’Essuubi ly’abatalina ssuubi,
ani gwe nzija okuddamu singa si ggwe?
content-lg.Pray this prayer once a day for 30 days: Saba essaala eno omulundi gumu buli lunaku okumala ennaku 30
content-lg.Obtain for me, then,\nO Mother of Hope,\:
Nnyamba, O Maama w’Essuubi,
ompe ekisa ky’okwennyika okutuufu olw’ebibi byange,
ekirabo eky’okukkiriza obulungi mu kigendererwa kya Katonda Ekitukuvu,
n’obuvumu okutwala omusalaba gwange n’okugoberera Yesu.
Saba ku Mutima Gwe Omutukuvu
ekisa eky’enjawulo kye nsaba mu novena eno.
content-lg.Pray the same prayer each day, for 30 da: Saba essaala y'emu buli lunaku, okumala ennaku 30 eziddiringana.
content-lg.But above all I pray,\nO dearest Mother,:
Naye okusinga byonna nsaba,
O maama wange omwagalwa,
nti ng’okuyita mu kwegayirira kwo okw’amaanyi ennyo,
omutima gwange gubeere n’Essuubi Ery’Obutukuvu,
kale mu kiseera ekizibu ennyo mu bulamu,
nsobole obutalemererwa kwesiga Katonda Omulokozi wange,
naye nga ntambulira mu makubo g’amateeka Ge,
nsobole okufuna omukisa okubeera awamu Naye,
nawe mu ssanyu ery’emirembe gyonna mu ggulu.
content-lg.Listen, then, I beg you, with fatherly c: Wulira, kale, nkwegayiridde, n'okufaayo kwa kitaawe, eri okusaba kwange okw'amazima, onfunire ebirungi bye nsaba.
content-lg.I ask it by the infinite mercy of the et: Nkibuuza mu kisa ekitaggwaawo eky'Omwana wa Katonda ow'emirembe gyonna, eyakubirizibwa okutwala obulamu bwaffe n'okuzaalibwa mu nsi eno ey'ennaku.
content-lg.I ask it by the loveliness and power of: Nkibuuza mu bulungi n'amaanyi g'erinnya eryo ettukuvu, Yesu, lye mwawa omwana oyo omuto.
content-lg.Ever blessed and glorious Joseph, kind a: Oli omusanyufu era ow'ekitiibwa Joseph, kitaawe omulungi era omwagalwa, era mukwano gw'abo bonna abali mu nnaku! Oli kitaawe omulungi era omukuumi w'abaana abatalina bazadde, omukuuma abatalina buyambi, omuwagizi w'abo abali mu bwetaavu n'ennaku. Laba ku kusaba kwange n'obulungi. Ebibi byange binzizaako obutali bulungi bwa Katonda wange, era kati ndi mu nnaku ennyingi. Gyoli, omukuumi omwagalwa w'Ekika ky'e Nazareth, njija gyoli okufuna obuyambi n'okukuuma.
content-lg.I ask it by the weariness and suffering: Nkibuuza ku buggya n’okubonaabona kwe mwagumira nga temulina we musula mu kisulo ky’e Betelehemu eri Omukyala omutukuvu, oba ennyumba omwana wa Katonda gy’ayinza okuzaalirwa. Oluvannyuma ng’abantu bonna bamugaana, wateekwa okukkiriza Kabaka w’eggulu okuzaala Omulokozi w’ensi mu mpuku.
content-lg.I ask it by that painful torture you fel: Nkibuuza nga nkozesa obulumi bw'okutulugunyizibwa kwe wawulira mu bunnabbi bwa Simeoni omutukuvu, eyalangirira omwana Yesu ne Maama we omutukuvu ng'abanaaba aboonoonyi baffe era olw'okutwagala ennyo.
content-lg.I ask it by all your care to protect the: Nkikusaba mu buvunaanyizibwa bwo bwonna okukuuma Omwana Omutukuvu n’Maama we omutukuvu mu lugendo lwo olw’okubiri, bwe wategekebwa okuddayo mu ggwanga lyo. Nkikusaba mu bulamu bwo obw’emirembe e Nazareth gye wasanga essanyu n’obulumi bungi.
content-lg.I ask it through your sorrow and pain of: Nkibuuza mu nnaku n’obulumi bw’omutima gwo bwe malayika yakulangirira nti obulamu bw’Omwana Yesu bwali buvumbuddwa abalabe be. Okuva mu kutegeka kwabwe okubi, walina okudduka naye ne Nnyina Omukisa okugenda e Misiri. Nkibuuza mu bulumi bwonna, okukoowa n’okufuba ku lugendo olwo olw’amaanyi era olw’akabi.
content-lg.I ask it by your great distress when the: Nkikubuuza mu kusaasira kwammwe okungi bwe mwafiirwa Omwana omulungi era nnyina we n’abula ennaku ssatu. Nkikubuuza mu ssanyu lyammwe ery’okumuzuula mu Yeekaalu, ne mu buwanguzi bw’omukisa gwe mwafuna e Nazareth nga mubeera wamu n’Omwana Yesu. Nkikubuuza mu kusaba okw’enjawulo kwe yalaga ng’akugondera.
content-lg.I ask it through Mary’s glorious Assumpt: Nkibuuza mu kugulumizibwa kwa Mary, n'essanyu eryo eritaggwawo ly'olina naye ng'oli ne Katonda.
content-lg.O good father! I beg you, by all your su: O taata omulungi! Nkwegayirira, mu kubonaabona kwo kwonna, ennaku zo n'essanyu lyo, ompulire era onfunire ekyo kye nsaba.
content-lg.I ask it by the perfect love and conform: Nkibuuza mu kwagala okutuufu n’okukkiriza kwe walaga ng’okkiriza ekiragiro kya Katonda okuva mu bulamu buno, n’okuva mu mukwano gwa Yesu ne Mariya. Nkibuuza mu ssanyu eryajjuza omutima gwo, nga Omulokozi w’ensi, ng’awangudde okufa n’omuliro ogutazikira, yayingira mu bwakabaka bwe era n’akuleeta mu bwo n’ekitiibwa eky’enjawulo.
content-lg.O God, who said let the little children: Ai Katonda, ani eyagamba abaana abato bajje gyendi era ayagala abaana, nsaba onnyambe okuddamu essaala ze nsaba mu novena eno ng’oyita mu kusabira kwa bannaddiini abatuukirivu, naddala
content-lg.Obtain for all those who have asked my p: Funa eri bonna abasabye okusaba kwange buli kimu ekibayamba mu nteekateeka ya Katonda. Ku nkomerero, mukwano gwange era kitaawe wange, beera nange n’abo bonna abankwatako mu kiseera kyaffe eky’enkomerero, tusobole okuyimba obulamu bwonna ekitiibwa kya Yesu, Mary ne Joseph.
content-lg.Most Holy Mother, hear the cries of my h: Maama Omutukuvu, wulira okukaaba kw'omutima gwange kati. Omukyala omugole omutukuvu, njagala okuba n'ebibala, naye sinnaweebwa mukisa gwa kuzaala. Nnyamba onnyambe okufuna obusobozi bw'okuzaala mu bulamu bwange era onzikize okubonaabona kwange.
content-lg.O good St Gerard, powerful intercessor b: Omutukuvu Gerard omulungi, omusabirizi ow'amaanyi mu maaso ga Katonda era omukozi w'ebyewuunyo mu kiseera kyaffe, nkwesiga era nkusaba obuyambi bwo.
content-lg.Prayer to Sts. Joachim and Anne: Okusaba eri abatukuvu. Joachim ne Anne
content-lg.Help make me a fruitful vine within my h: Munnyambe onkoze omuzabbibu ogw’amaanyi mu nnyumba yange. Abaana bange banaaba nga amatabi g’omuyembe okwetooloola emmeeza yange. Maama w’ekisa, mmanyi nti saakolebwa kubeera atalina bibala, naye Omwana wo yankola okubeera ow’amaanyi mu byonna bye nkola. Mmanyi nti ekiseera kyange eky’okubala kinaajja ng’okusinzira ku kiseera ky’Omwana wo. Amiina.
content-lg.Help us to conceive a child so that we m: Tuyambe okufuna omwana tusobole okumukuza n'omutima omulungi nga bwe wakola.
content-lg.Most Holy Saints Anne and Joachim, come: Abatukuvu abasinga obutukuvu Anne ne Yokaamu, mujje okumpi naffe mutukuume mu mikono gyaffe ne mu mitima gyaffe mu kkubo ery'obulungi.
content-lg.You always fulfilled God’s designs, help: Buli kiseera wawanga obulamu bw’ekigendererwa kya Katonda, nnyamba kati okukola ebyo byonna Katonda by’ayagala. Saba Mukama w’Obulamu, eyavaamu abazadde bonna, ampe abaana bangi nsobole okukuza abaana eri Katonda mu bulamu buno ne mu nsi ejja, nga bali basika ba Bwakabaka bwe Obugulumivu. Amiina.
content-lg.Obtain from God the grace to overcome al: Tufune okuva eri Katonda ekisa eky'okuvvuunuka obutazaala tusobole okukuza abaana baffe mu kukkiriza era tuzze amaka gaffe mu kitangaala kya Yesu.
content-lg.Sts Anne and Joachim, we place our petit: Sts Anne ne Joachim, tukuteeka okusaba kwaffe mu mikono gyo era tusaba nti okukuteeke mu maaso ga Yesu omwana. Amiina.
content-lg.Prayer to St. Raphael to Heal Infertilit: Okusaba kwa St. Raphael okuwonya obutazaala
content-lg.Glorious Archangel St. Raphael, great pr: Malayika omukulu omutukuvu St. Raphael, omulangira omukulu ow'omu luggya olw'eggulu, oli wa kitiibwa olw'ebirabo byo eby'amagezi n'ekisa.
content-lg.O glorious St. Colette, I beseech you th: Omutukuvu St. Colette omulungi, nkusaba okuyita mu kwagala okw’amaanyi okwakuma omutima gwo eri Yesu mu Sakramentu Ekitukuvu Ennyo, okuyita mu mikisa egy’ekitalo gy’awaddeyo, n’okuyita mu kisa eky’amaanyi ky’owaddeyo mu kubonaabona kwe, onfunire okuva gy’ali okusaba kwange okw’obuzadde kye nsuubira okufuna okuyita mu kusaba kwo okw’amaanyi. Amiina.
content-lg.You are a guide of those who journey by: Oli mugobererezi w’abo abakola olugendo ku ttaka, ku nnyanja oba mu bbanga, omusanyusa abalina ennaku, era ekifo ky’okusabirako aboonoonyi. Nkusaba onnyambe mu byetaago byange byonna ne mu bulumi bwonna obw’obulamu buno, nga bwe wayamba Tobias omuto mu lugendo lwe.
content-lg.Because you are the Medicine of God, I h: Olw'okuba ggwe ddagala lya Katonda, nkusaba mu buwombeefu okuwonya obulwadde bungi obuli mu mwoyo gwange n'obulwadde obukosa omubiri gwange, nga nnyo nnyo obutazaala.
content-lg.I also ask for the great grace of purity: Era nsaba ekisa eky'amaanyi eky'obulongoofu okunteekateeka okubeera yeekaalu y'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.
content-lg.Novena to Our Lady of Fatima: Novena eri Mukama waffe ow'e Fatima
content-lg.Our Lady of the Rosary, who appeared to: Mukama waffe ow'ekisakiro, eyalabikira abaana abasatu abasumba
content-lg.Founder of the Order of Preachers and ap: Eyatandikawo ekibiina ky'Ababuulizi era omubaka w'ekisabiro kya Rozali
content-lg.Novena to Our Lady of Sorrows: Okusaba kwa Novena eri Our Lady of Sorrows
Mukama, twasaasire. Kristo, tuwulire.
Kristo, mu kisa otuwulire.
content-lg.Queen conceived without the stain of Ori:
Kwiini yafuna olubuto nga talina kibi ky'ekibi ekisooka,
tusabire.
content-lg.That I may love God with all my heart,\n:
Nsobole okwagala Katonda n'omutima gwange gwonna,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may always shun sin, the only rea:
Nnyinza okwewala ekibi, ekintu kyokka eky'obubi,
Jjangu onnyambe, O Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.O Mother of Perpetual Help,\nwhose very:
O Maama w'Obuyambi obutaggwaawo,
erinnya lye eryenyini erireeta obwesige,
Jjangu onnyambe, O Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may in all things conform my will:
Nnyinza okukola ebintu byonna nga nkwatagana
n'ekyo ky'Omwana wo ow'Obwakatonda,
Jjangu onnyambe, Omuzaala wange omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may often and devoutly receive th:
Nsobole okufuna obulungi ekitambiro,
Nnyamba nnyo, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may always remember my last end,\:
Nsobole okujjukira bulijjo enkomerero yange eyasembayo,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama ow'okwagala.
content-lg.That I may never neglect prayer,\nCome t:
Nsobole obutaleka kusaba,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may avoid every proximate occasio:
Nnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa,
Nsobole okwewala ekintu kyonna eky'ekibi.
content-lg.That I may always be victorious in the h:
Nsobole okuwangula mu ssaawa y'okukemebwa,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may ever remember to invoke thee,:
Nsobole okujjukira okukusaba,
naddala mu kiseera ky'okukemebwa,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may courageously resist the seduc:
Nze nsobole okuziyiza obulungi bwa banne ababi,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may be strong against my own inco:
Nsobole okubeera omunywevu nga nneerwanako,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama ow'okwagala.
content-lg.That I may generously pardon my enemies,:
Nsobole okusonyiwa abalabe bange mu ngeri ey'ekisa,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama ow'okwagala.
content-lg.That I may arise quickly,\nshould I have:
Nsobole okusituka amangu,
bwe mba nga nfuna obuzibu bw'okugwa mu kibi eky'amaanyi,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may ever love to serve thee,\nCom:
Nsobole okukwagala nnyo okukuweereza,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may labor zealously to eradicate:
Nsobole okukola n'amaanyi okumalawo emize gyange emibi,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may lead others to love and serve:
Nsobole okukulembera abalala mu kwagala n'okukuweereza,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may not delay my conversion from:
Nze nneme okukaluba mu kukyuka kwange okuva olunaku ku lunaku,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.In sickness and pain,\nCome to my aid, O:
Mu bulwadde n'obulumi,
Jjangu onnyambe, O Mukyala omwagalwa.
content-lg.In poverty and distress,\nCome to my aid:
Mu bwavu n'okubonaabona,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.In all necessities of body and soul,\nCo:
Mu byetaago byonna eby'omubiri n'emmeeme,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.That I may live and die in the friendshi:
Nsobole okubeera mu mukwano gwa Katonda,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama ow'okwagala.
content-lg.In grief and dereliction of mind,\nCome:
Mu nnaku n'okweraliikirira,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.In persecution and abandonment,\nCome to:
Mu kuyigganyizibwa n'okulekebwa,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When assailed by the evil spirits,\nCome:
Bwe nkwatibwa emyoyo emibi,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When tempted by the allurements of a dec:
Bw'okemebwa okukwegomba kw'ensi eno ey'obulimba,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.In every danger of sin,\nCome to my aid,:
Mu buli kabi ak'ekibi,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.In time of war, famine and contagion,\nC:
Mu kiseera ky'olutalo, enjala n'obulwadde,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When struggling against the inclinations:
Bwe mba nga nneekalakaasa olw'obutali butuukirivu bwange,
Nnyamba, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When tempted against the holy virtue of:
Bwe tukemebwa okukola ekibi eky'obutali bulongoofu,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When death is nigh,\nCome to my aid, O l:
Okufa bwe kuba nga kutuuse,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When the loss of my senses\nshall warn m:
Obudde bw'okufiirwa obusobozi bwange
bwe bunzijukiza nti omulimu gwange ogw'ensi guwedde,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama ow'okwagala.
content-lg.When the thought of my approaching disso:
Bwe ndowooza ku kuggwaawo kwange okusembera,
Nzijukira ntya era ne ntandika okutya ennyo,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama omwagalwa.
content-lg.When at the decisive hour of death,\nthe:
Bwe mba mu kaseera akazibu ennyo,
omwoyo omubi ajja kugezaako okunzisaamu essuubi,
Jjangu onnyambe, Omuzaala wange ow'okwagala.
content-lg.When the priest of God shall give me\nhi:
Bw'anaaba nga omusumba wa Katonda
ampa okusonyiyibwa kwe okusembayo n'omukisa gwe ogusembayo,
Jjangu onnyambe, ggwe Maama ow'okwagala.
content-lg.When I shall yield my soul into the hand:
Bwe ndiwaayo emmeeme yange mu mikono gy'Omutonzi waayo,

content-lg.O Almighty and merciful God, Who, in ord: Katonda Omuyinza w'ebintu byonna era ow'ekisa, Ayagala okuyamba abantu, yasalawo Omukama omulungi Maria afuuke Maama w'Omwana wo omu yekka, tumusaba atuyambe okuyita mu kusabira kwe tulyoke twewale ekibi n'okukola ebirungi nga tukozesa omutima ogw'amazima, okuyita mu Kristo Mukama waffe.
content-lg.O Mother of Perpetual Help, grant that I: O Maama w'Obuyambi obutaggwaawo, mpa omukisa nsobole okusaba erinnya lyo ery'amaanyi, obukuumi eri abalamu n'okulokola abafa.
content-lg.Purest Mary, let your name henceforth be: Mariya omulongoofu, erinnya lyo okuva kati libeere ku mimwa gyange bulijjo. Tolemererwa, Mukyala Omusanyufu, okunzizaamu amaanyi buli lwe nkuyita.
content-lg.In my temptations, in my needs, I will n: Mu kugezesebwa kwange, mu byetaago byange, sijja kulekera awo kukusaba, nga nkyusa erinnya lyo ery'ekitiibwa, Mariya, Mariya.

content-lg.What a consolation, what sweetness, what: Kino kya kuzzaamu amaanyi, obulungi bwe, okwesiga okujjuza emmeeme yange nga nnyumya erinnya lyo ettukuvu oba ne bw’oba ng’okulowoozaako! Nneebaza Mukama olw’okuwa erinnya eryo ekkiriza, ery’amaanyi era ery’obulungi.
content-lg.But I will not be content with merely ut: Naye sijja kumatira na kwogera erinnya lyo kyokka. Okwagala kwange okukuliiko kukole nga kunziza bulijjo okukuwa ekitiibwa, Maama w’Obuyambi Obutaggwaawo. Maama w’Obuyambi Obutaggwaawo, nsabire era onnyambe mu byonna bye nkusaba n’obwesige
