content-lg.Most Holy Virgin, who deigned to come to: Omutukuvu Omusajja Omutukuvu, eyakkiriza okujja e Fatima okulaga abasumba abato basatu obugagga bw’obulungi obwekutte mu kusoma Rosary, atukubirize emitima gyaffe n’okwagala okutuufu ku kwegatta kuno, tusobole okuwandiika ku byama by’okununulwa kwaffe ebisangibwa mu kusoma kuno, tusobole okufuna ebibala n’okukyusa aboonoonyi, okukyusa Russia n’ekisa kino kye nsaba nnyo
content-lg.My God, I believe, I adore, I hope and I: Katonda wange, nzikiriza, nkwagala, nsuubira era nkukwatako! Nsaba okusonyiyibwa gy’oli ku abo abatannakkiriza, abatannakwagala, abatannasuubira era abatannakwagala. Omutukuvu Katonda Omusatu, Kitaffe, Omwana ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu, nkukwatako nnyo, era nkuwa omubiri ogusinga obulungi, omusaayi, emmeeme n’obutukuvu bwa Yesu Kristo, ali mu masinzizo gonna ag’ensi, ng’asasula olw’okukola ebibi, okunyooma n’obutafaayo kwe yennyini akwatiddwa. Era, okuyita mu bulungi obutaggwaawo bw’Omutima gwe Omutukuvu ennyo, n’Omutima omutukuvu ogwa Maryamu, nkusaba okukyusa aboonoona abatalina kyekikulu.
content-lg.O renowned champion of the faith of Chri: Omuvubuka omumanyiddwa ennyo mu kukkiriza kwa Kristu, omutukuvu Dominic omutukuvu ennyo, eyaleka ekitiibwa n’obugagga bw’ensi okusanyusa abavu, abakozi, era abawulirizibwa obulumi obw’okutambulira mu bulamu obulina okwawula omuyigirizwa we Oyo agamba nti: Omuntu yenna bw’aba ayagala okunkolera emabega, amuteekeko omusalaba gwe angoberere.
content-lg.Thou, O great Saint, regardest as nothin: Gwe, Omutukuvu omukulu, tolowooza ku buzibu bwonna bwe wawulira oba emirimu gyonna gye wakola okutumbula ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekitukuvu; nkwegayiridde, nfuna okwagala okwo okw’amaanyi okwakusobozesa, kunnyumire emirimu, okuswazibwa, okuswaza, oba ebintu ebirala byonna bye nnaasobola okufiirwa olw’erinnya lya Yesu.
content-lg.O burning torch, who being thyself consu: O torch eyaka, ggwe nga wekka okyayokebwa omuliro gw’okwagala kwa Katonda, wakola bulijjo okukuma omuliro ogutukuvu mu mitima gy’abalala, nnyonera wansi okuva ku kiti ky’obugagga gy’ofunira empeera y’emirimu gyo gyonna, onfunireko obusannyalazo bw’omuliro ogwo ogw’ekisa bubeere mu mwoyo gwange, okunyweza n’okunsanyusa mu buvunaanyizibwa oba ebigezo byonna Katonda by’anaakiriza okunkuba.
content-lg.I praise and thank God for the high degr: Ntendereza era neebaza Katonda olw'obutukuvu obungi bwe yakuwa, n'enkizo ez'enjawulo z'akugabira.
content-lg.May I ever bear in mind that nothing can: Nnyinza okujjukira nti tewali kintu kyonna kisobola kunzizaako wabula nga Katonda ow’amagezi agatagambika, era amanyi ekisinga obulungi eri obulamu bwange; ow’amaanyi agatagambika, era asobola okukikola; ate okusinga byonna, ow’ekisa ekitagambika n’okwagala, eyawaayo obulamu bwe ku lwange, era akiraga buli lunaku mu kwagala kwe n’obugabi bwe.
content-lg.O tender Father of the poor who, when al: Omutonzi wa taata w'abavu, eyawaddeyo obulamu bwe okubayamba nga ebintu byonna bikendedde, nkusaba onnyambe nfune omwoyo ogw'obusaasizi eri abo abali mu bulumi mu Yesu Kristo, ogwalaga mu bulamu bwo obutukuvu.
content-lg.To Our Lady, Queen of the Rosary: Eri Mukama waffe, Kwiini w'Essaala ya Rozali
content-lg.Obtain likewise the favours I request in: Funa mu ngeri y'emu ebirungi bye nsaba mu Novena eno, okuyitira mu kusabira kwo okw'amaanyi.
content-lg.May I, by charity to those whom Jesus so: Nnyinza, nga nkozesa obulungi bwange eri abo Yesu b’ayagala ennyo, okuteekateeka eby’obugagga mu ggulu, gy’oli kati weewummulira ekyo amaaso gatakirabye, wadde okutu kwawulidde, wadde omutima gw’omuntu gwakitegedde, naye Katonda ky’ataddewo eri abamwagala era abakakasa nga bayizi be nga bakwata amateeka ge ag’obutukuvu: mwagalane.
content-lg.I ask thee, by that gratitude with which: Nkwebuuza, olw'okusiima kwe onookozesa okumala emirembe gyonna okukusanyusa Omutonzi wo ow'ekitalo, nsaba ompe ekisa okuggya mu mutima gwange buli kimu kyonna ekitali kirungi mu maaso ge, naddala empisa embi gye nkola ennyo nga mmunyiiza.
content-lg.O glorious Mother of God, Queen of the m: O Mukama w'ekitiibwa, Maama wa Katonda, Kabaka w'Omusaalaba ogutukuvu ennyo, ggwe eyayagala Dominic ng'omukwano gw'omuzadde, era n'okwagalwa n'okuweebwa ekitiibwa mu maaso ge, ndabirira, ku lw'obulungi bwe, n'amaaso ag'ekisa, okwegatta naye mu kuleeta okusaba kuno eri Yesu wo omutukuvu.
content-lg.I sincerely desire from this moment to l: Nnyinza okwagala okuva kati okumwagala n'omutima gwange gwonna, era okumuweereza n'amaanyi gange gonna, era kati nteeka obulamu bwange mu bukuumi bwo obw'amaanyi, nga kino kyekyokukozesa okufuna ebirungi byonna ebyetaagisa okumuweereza mu bwesigwa wano, nsobole okusanyuka naye emirembe gyonna. Amiina.
content-lg.Look with favor upon me, a poor sinner,: Nnyonera ekisa, omwonoonyi omwavu, era onfunire okuva mu Mwana wo ebirungi byonna bye nneetaaga okugumira okubonaabona Katonda kw'ankkiriza okwolekagana nakwo.
content-lg.O sorrowful Mother, I turn to you in tot: O Maama ow'ennaku, nkwesigamako mu bwesige obujjuvu. Wabonaabona ennyo mu bulamu, ng'olaba Omwana wo afa ku Musalaba, era wabangawo okutuuka ku nkomerero.
content-lg.O Mother of Sorrows, through thy First S:
O Maama w'Okunakuwala, okuyita mu Kunakuwala kwo Okusooka, Obunnabbi bwa Simeoni Omutukuvu, onkwatireko n'Omutima omutukuvu gwa Yesu, era ompa ekisa kye nsaba

content-lg.On the Cross her Son was dying.\nMary st:

content-lg.O Mother of the Word Incarnate, despise: O Maama w'Ekigambo Ekifuuse Omuntu, tokolokota kusaba kwange, naye mu kisa kyo, mpuliriza era onziramu. Amiina.
content-lg.Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary, t: Jjukira, O Mawulire Omugole Maryamu, nti tewali muntu yenna eyadduka okufuna obukuumi bwo, n’asaba obuyambi bwo oba n’anoonya okusabirwa kwo, eyalekebwa nga talina buyambi. Nga nsikiriziddwa ku bwesige buno, nkuleetera eri, O Mugole w’Abagole, Maama wange. Nkujja gyoli, mu maaso go nnyimiridde, nga ndi munyoomi era omunakuwavu.

content-rny.Come into our hearts, that Thy Holy Spir: Ija omu mitima yaitu, ngu Omwoyo waawe Orikwera asabe omuriitwe kandi ahabwaitu; kandi otuhe embabazi, kurabira omu iziina eryo eririkusiimwa, eri n'okushemererwa kw'omu iguru, okutiinisa kw'omu geyena, okuhuumuriza abarikubonabona, hamwe n'omusingye gw'obwesigye bwaitu obutarikuhwaho, okushaba kwona oku turikukora omu Novena egi.

content-rny.Beg, also, that the most ardent love may: Kandi, shaba ngu rukundo erikukirayo obw'amaani eshemereire kuta omu mitima yaitu eiziina eryo eririkwera, kugira ngu rishemereire kuba riri omu biteekateeko byaitu obwire bwona, kandi rikakira kugambwa aha minwa yaitu; kugira ngu rishemereire kuba niryo burinzi bwaitu omu kwohibwa, hamwe n'obuhungiro bwaitu omu kabi, omu magara gaitu, hamwe n'okuhuumuriza kwaitu hamwe n'obuhwezi omu shaaha y'okufa.

content-rny.After each line, answer: deliver us, O J: Bwanyima ya buri runyiriri, garukamu: otuheereze, O Yesu.

content-rny.Grant, we beg Thee, to us who ask it, th: Grant, nitushaba Ruhanga, ahariitwe abarikukishaba, ekiconco ky'okukunda kwe okw'oburungi bwingi, ngu tubaase kukundakwe n'omutima gwaitu gwona, omu kigambo hamwe n'omu bikorwa, kandi tutarikuhwa kuhimbisa Ruhanga.
content-rny.Give us, O Lord, as much a lasting fear: Tuheereze, Mukama waitu, okutiina okurikugumaho nk'oku orikukunda eiziina ryawe eririkwera, ahabwokuba iwe, orikubaho kandi ori Omugabe ebiro byona n'ebyo, torikubaasa kuremwa kutegyeka abo abu waataireho omu kukunda kwawe.
content-rny.O Blessed Virgin Mary,\nMother of Grace,:
O Blessed Virgin Mary,
Maama w'embabazi, amatsiko g'ensi.
Twihurire, abaana baawe, abarikukweta.
content-rny.I am the mother of fair love, and of fea:
Ndi nyina w'okukunda okurungi, hamwe n'okutiina,
hamwe n'obwengye, hamwe n'amatsiko marungi.
Omu nyowe harimu embabazi zoona ez'omuhanda hamwe n'amazima;
omu nyowe harimu amatsiko goona ag'amagara hamwe n'emitwarize mirungi.
Ija aha nyowe abo boona abarikunyenda
kandi obaase kujwiibwa ebijuma byangye (Sirach 24:24-26).
content-rny.O God, who by the marvelous protection\n:
Ai Ruhanga, orikurinda omu muringo gw'okutangaaza
ogwa Mariya Omukama w'ekitiinisa
otugumize munonga omu kubaasa,
twakushaba ngu,
turikuguma nitushaba aha buhabuzi bwe,
tubaase kutunga obuhwezi obu turikweshengyereza.
Kurabira omuri Kristo Mukama waitu.
content-rny.O Mary, my Mother,\nI kneel before you w:
O Mary, Maama wangye,
Ninkutama omu maisho gaawe n'omutima ogurikuremera.
Omugugu gw'ebibi byangye nigunyigiriza.
Okumanya obweremwa bwangye nikunshobera.
Nimpikirizibwa okutiina hamwe n'okwohibwa kw'emiringo yoona.
Kwonka ninyine enkoragana y'amaani n'ebintu by'ensi egi
ekirikumanyisa ngu omu mwanya gw'okwenda kugyenda omu iguru
nimpikirizibwa okutiina ahabw'ekiteekateeko ky'okufa.
content-rny.O Mother of Mercy,\nhave pity on me in m:
O Maama w'embabazi,
nyikiriza obusaasi bwangye omu kubonabona kwangye.
Oine amaani goona n'Omwana waawe ow'obuhangwa.
Tarabaasa kugaana ekishaba kyona eky'omutima gwawe ogutarimu kibi.
Nyoreka ngu ori Maama w'amazima ahariinye
orikubaasa kuba omurwanirizi wangye omu maisho g'entebe ye.
O Obuhungiro bw'Abasiisi
kandi Amatsiko g'Abatarikugira matsiko,
ninyija kuhindukira oha ku oraabe otari iwe?
content-rny.Obtain for me, then,\nO Mother of Hope,\:
Nkushaba, nyina w'okuhuumuriza,
obugabe bw'okusaasira kw'amazima ahabw'ebibi byangye,
ekiconco ky'okurekurira kimwe omu kigyendererwa kya Ruhanga eky'obutukuvu,
hamwe n'obumanzi bw'okutwara omusaraba gwangye n'okukuratira Yesu.
Shaba omutima gwe ogurikwera
obuhwezi obw'omutaano obu ndikushaba omu novena egi.
content-rny.But above all I pray,\nO dearest Mother,:
Kwonka okukira byona nshaba,
O maama wange omukundwa,
 ngu kurabira omu kushaba kwawe okw'amaani
omutima gwangye gushemereire kujurirwa amatsiko marungi,
kugira ngu omu bwire bw'amagara oburikukirayo oburemeezi
ntakagume kugumizamu ninteekateeka ahari Ruhanga Omujuni wangye,
kwonka ndikugyenda omu muhanda gw'ebiragiro bye
nimbasa kuhikiiriza kuba hamwe nawe,
hamwe naiwe omu mashemererwa agatahwaho aga Iguru.
content-rny.Pray the same prayer each day, for 30 da: Shaba eshaara emwe buri izooba, okumara ebiro 30 byona.
content-rny.Pray this prayer once a day for 30 days: Shaba eshaara egi omurundi gumwe buri izooba kumara ebiro 30
content-rny.Listen, then, I beg you, with fatherly c: Muhurikize, nimbashaba, ahabw'okufayo kwa taata, okushaba kwangye okw'amazima, kandi mungarukiremu obuheereza obu ndikushaba.
content-rny.I ask it by the infinite mercy of the et: Ninkishaba ahabw'embabazi zitarikuhwa ez'omwana wa Ruhanga ow'obutwire, owayehaireyo kutwara obuhangwa bwaitu n'okuzaarirwa omunsi egi y'okushoberwa.
content-rny.I ask it by the loveliness and power of: Ninkibuuza omu rukundo n'amaani g'eiziina eryo eririkwera, Yesu, eri waheire omwana w'omukazi.
content-rny.Ever blessed and glorious Joseph, kind a: Joseph owabaire ari omugisha kandi ow'ekitiinisa, taata w'embabazi kandi orikukunda, hamwe n'omunywani orikuhwera abo boona abari omu busaasi! Ori taata murungi kandi omurwanirizi w'efuuzi, omurwanirizi w'abarikwetenga obuhwezi, omurwanirizi w'abo abarikwetenga obuhwezi hamwe n'obusaasi. Reeba embabazi omu kushaba kwangye. Ebibi byangye bitungire okutashemererwa kwa Ruhanga wangye, nahabwekyo nshwekirwe obutashemererwa. Aha iwe, omurwanirizi w'eka ya Nazareth, niinyija kukushaba obuhwezi hamwe n'oburinzi.
content-rny.I ask it by the weariness and suffering: Ninkibuuza ahabw'oburuhe n'okubonabona oku waagumisiriza obu waashanga otaine butaaho omu nju ya Bethlehem ahabwa Omukazi orikwera, kandi otaine nju ei Omwana wa Ruhanga yaabaire naabaasa kuzaarirwamu. Obwo, obwo orikwanga buri hamwe, okaba oine kwikiriza Omugabekazi w'omu Iguru kuzaara Omucunguzi w'ensi omu mpuku.
content-rny.I ask it by that painful torture you fel: Ninkibuuza kurabira omu kubonabonesa okwabaireho ahabw'okugamba kw'obunabi bwa Simeoni orikwera, okwarangirire ngu Omwana Yesu hamwe na nyina we orikwera bakaba nibaija kuba abarikubonabonesibwa ebibi byaitu hamwe n'okukunda kwabo okw'amaani ahariitwe.
content-rny.I ask it by all your care to protect the: Ninkishaba omu kureeberera kwawe kwona okurinda Omwana w'ekitiinisa hamwe na Nyina we ow'obutaine kamogo omu rugyendo rwawe orwa kabiri, obu waaragiirwe kugaruka omu ihanga ryawe. Ninkishaba omu magara gaawe ag'obusingye omuri Nazareth ahu waabugaine n'okushemererwa kwingi hamwe n'obusaasi bwingi.
content-rny.I ask it through your sorrow and pain of: Ninkibuuza kurabira omu kushoberwa kwawe hamwe n'obusaasi bw'omutima obu maraika yaarangirira ahariiwe ngu amagara g'omwana Yesu gakaba nigasherurwa abazigu be. Kuruga omu nteekateeka yaabo embi okaba oine kuhunga nawe hamwe na nyina we owabaire ari omugisha kuza Misiri. Ninkibuuza kurabira omu kubonabona kwona, oburuhe, hamwe n'emirimo y'orugyendo orwo oruraihire kandi orw'akabi.
content-rny.I ask it by your great distress when the: Ninkibuuza ahabw'obusaasi bwawe oburikukirayo obu Omwana ow'okusiimwa yaabura ahariiwe hamwe na Nyina kumara ebiro bishatu. Ninkibuuza ahabw'okushemererwa kwawe okw'okumushanga omu hekalu, hamwe n'okuhuumurizibwa oku waatungire omuri Nazareeti, obu waabaire nootuurana n'omwana Yesu. Ninkibuuza ahabw'okworobera okurikutangaaza oku yaayorekire omu kworoba kwe ahariiwe.
content-rny.I ask it through Mary’s glorious Assumpt: Ninkishaba kurabira omuri Mary ow'ekitiinisa ky'okutwara Ruhanga, kandi kurabira omu okushemererwa okutarikuhwa oku oine nawe omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
content-rny.O good father! I beg you, by all your su: Otaata murungi! Ninkushaba, ahabw'okubonabona kwawe kwona, obusaasi bwawe, hamwe n'okushemererwa kwawe, ngu ompurikize kandi onshabire eki ndikushaba.
content-rny.I ask it by the perfect love and conform: Ninkibuuza omu rukundo rw'amaani hamwe n'okwikirizana oku waayorekire omu kwikiriza entebeekanisa y'Obwa Ruhanga kushohora omu magara aga, hamwe n'omu kibiina kya Yesu na Mariya. Ninkibuuza omu kushemererwa okwabaire kwiijwire omu mutima gwawe, obu Omucunguzi w'ensi, arikusingura okufa hamwe n'omuriro ogutaraara, yaataaha omu bugabe bwe kandi yaakwebembera omuri bwo n'ekitiinisa ky'omutaano.
content-rny.O God, who said let the little children: Ai Ruhanga, owaagambire ngu abaana bato baije ahariinye kandi orikukunda abaana, nkweshengyereza garukamu okushaba kwangye omu novena egi kurabira omu kuhurikiriza kwa baahure, namunonga
content-rny.Obtain for all those who have asked my p: Muhindure abo boona abaashabire okushaba kwangye buri kimwe ekirabasa kubayamba omu nteekateeka ya Ruhanga. Aha muheru, omukundwa wangye kandi taata, guma naiwe hamwe naabo boona abarikunkunda omu bwire bw'ahamuheru, ngu tubaase kweshongora ebyeshongoro bya Yesu, Mariya na Yozefu ebiro byona.
content-rny.Most Holy Mother, hear the cries of my h: Omukazi Orikwera, hurira okurira kw'omutima gwangye hati. Omukazi w'ekitiinisa, ninyenda kuba ow'okubanza, kwonka tinkabaire nimbwa omugisha gw'okuzaara. Nkaha omugisha gw'okuzaara aha magara gangye kandi omaririze okubonabona kwangye.
content-rny.Prayer to Sts. Joachim and Anne: Okushaba kwa Sts. Joachim na Anne
content-rny.O good St Gerard, powerful intercessor b: Ow'omugisha St Gerard, omuhwezi w'amaani omu maisho ga Ruhanga kandi omukozi w'ebihangirwe by'obunaku bwaitu, ninkushaba ndi n'obwesigye kandi nshaba obuhwezi bwawe.
content-rny.Help make me a fruitful vine within my h: Mpereza okundetera omuzabibu ogurikwera omu nju yangye. Abaana bangye nibaija kuba nk'ebishushani by'emizeyituuni aha meeza yangye. Maama w'embabazi, nimanya ngu tindahangirwe kugira ngu ndebe ekirikuruga omu kukora kwangye, kwonka Omwana waawe akandehanga kuba ow'omugasho omuri buri kimwe eki ndikukora. Nimanya ngu obwire bwangye bw'okuhingura nibwija kuhika kurugiirira aha bwire bw'Omwana waawe. Amiina.
content-rny.Most Holy Saints Anne and Joachim, come: Abatukuvu abarikwera munonga Anne na Yowakimu, mwije haihi naitwe kandi mutungye emikono yaitu hamwe n'emitima yaitu omumuhanda gw'oburungi.
content-rny.You always fulfilled God’s designs, help: Buriijo okahikiiriza enteekateeka ya Ruhanga, nyamba hati kukora ebyetengo bya Ruhanga ebirikwera. Shaba Mukama w'amagara, ahu obuzaire bwona burikuruga, kumpa abaana baingi, ngu nshoboorore abaana ba Ruhanga omu magara aga, hamwe n'omu nsi erikwija, abaragwa b'Obukama bw'ekitiinisa Kye. Amiina.
content-rny.Help us to conceive a child so that we m: Tuhwere kuteekateeka omwana kugira ngu tumureeberere n'omutima murungi nk'oku waakozire.
content-rny.Obtain from God the grace to overcome al: Tunga omugisha kuruga ahari Ruhanga kusingura obutazaara, tureebe ngu abaana baitu tubareeberera omu kwikiriza kandi tworekye amaka gaitu gatungye omushana gwa Yesu.
content-rny.Sts Anne and Joachim, we place our petit: Sts Anne na Joachim, nituta okushaba kwaitu omu mikono yaanyu kandi nitushaba ngu mukutware omu maisho ga Yesu omwana. Amen.
content-rny.Glorious Archangel St. Raphael, great pr: Omukwenda w'amaani St. Raphael, omunyiginya mukuru w'ekitongore ky'omu iguru, ori ow'omutaano ahabw'ebiconco byawe eby'obwengye hamwe n'embabazi.
content-rny.You are a guide of those who journey by: Ori omwebembezi w'abo abarikugyenda aha itaka nainga aha nyanja nainga omu mwanya, omuhuumuriza w'abarikubonabona, kandi obuhungiro bw'abasiisi. Ninkushaba, nyamba omu byetaago byangye byona hamwe n'omu kubonabona kw'amagara aga, nk'oku waahwereire Tobias omuto omu rugyendo rwe.
content-rny.Because you are the Medicine of God, I h: Ahabw'okuba ori omubazi gwa Ruhanga, ndakushaba n'obucureezi ngu okize oburwaire bwingi bw'omutima gwangye hamwe n'endwara ezirikubonabonesa omubiri gwangye, okukira munonga obutazaara.
content-rny.I also ask for the great grace of purity: Nimbaasa kushaba embabazi z'okuba oshemeire, kungarura omu mbeera y'okuba ekyombeko ky'omwoyo gurikwera.
content-rny.O glorious St. Colette, I beseech you th: Ow'ekitiinisa St. Colette, ninkushaba kurabira omu rukundo erikwotsya eyareteire omutima gwawe kugira okukunda Yesu omu Sacrament erikukirayo kuba ey'omugisha, kurabira omu migisha y'omutaano ei Yaakuhaire, hamwe n'embabazi z'okukunda ezi waamugiriire omu kubonabona kwe okwabaire kurimu obusaasi, ongambire aha bikwatiraine n'okushaba kwangye okw'okuzaara eki ndikwenda kutunga kurabira omu kushaba kwawe okw'amaani. Amen.
content-rny.Founder of the Order of Preachers and ap: Omutandiki w'ekitongore ky'ababuurizi kandi entumwa y'akatabo ka rozaari
content-rny.Our Lady of the Rosary, who appeared to: Omukama waitu ow'ekishushani ky'omusaraba, owaareebekire abaana bashatu abariisa
content-rny.Novena to Our Lady of Sorrows: Novena ahari Our Lady of Sorrows
content-rny.Novena to Our Lady of Fatima: Novena aha Mukama waitu ow'omuri Fatima

Tugirire embabazi.
content-rny.Queen conceived without the stain of Ori:

mutushabire.
content-rny.That I may love God with all my heart,\n:
Kugira ngu nkunde Ruhanga n'omutima gwangye gwona,
Ija onyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.O Mother of Perpetual Help,\nwhose very:
O Maama w'obuhwezi obutahwaho,
ow'eiziina rye eririkureeta obwesigye,
Ija omu buhwezi bwangye, O Maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may in all things conform my will:
Nimbaasa omu bintu byona kuhikaana n'ekigyendererwa
ky'omwana waawe ow'obwaruhanga,
Ija onyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may always shun sin, the only rea:
Nkabaasa kwanga ekibi, obubi bwonka obwabuzima,
Oyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may often and devoutly receive th:
Nimbaasa kuguma nintunga obujanjabi bw'okushaba,
Mama w'omukundwa, nyamba.
content-rny.That I may avoid every proximate occasio:
Nimbaasa kwetantara buri kintu kyona ekirikubaasa kurugamu ekibi,
Mukazi wangye orikundwa, nkwataho.
content-rny.That I may always remember my last end,\:
Kugira ngu ninyijuka okuhendera kwangye okwahererukireyo,
Ija omu kumpwera, O maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may generously pardon my enemies,:
Kugira ngu nshoboorore abazigu bangye,
Ija omu kumpwera, O maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may ever remember to invoke thee,:
Nimbaasa kwijuka kushaba,
okukira munonga omu bwire bw'okugyezibwa,
Ija onyambe, Omuzaire w'omukundwa.
content-rny.That I may always be victorious in the h:
Kugira ngu ngyende omu maisho okusingura omu shaaha y'okwohibwa,
Nkwataho, O Maama w'omukago.
content-rny.That I may never neglect prayer,\nCome t:
Kugira ngu ntakarekyera aho okushaba,
Nkwija kukuhwera, O Maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may be strong against my own inco:
Nimbaasa kuba ow'amaani omu butari bwesigwa bwangye,
Oyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may courageously resist the seduc:
Nkabaasa kugumisiriza okushendashenda kw'abanywani babi,
Ija omu maisho gangye, Owaamaama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may not delay my conversion from:
Kugira ngu ntarekye kuhindura okuruga aha izooba kuza aha rindi,
Ija omu kumpwera, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may arise quickly,\nshould I have:
Nimbaasa kuguruka ahonaaho,
Ku ndikuba nyine oburemeezi bw'okugwa omu kibi ky'okufa,
Ija ompwere, O maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may ever love to serve thee,\nCom:
Nimbaasa kukunda kukuheereza,
Ija omu buhwezi bwangye, O maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may live and die in the friendshi:
Nkabaasa kutuura kandi nkafa omu mukago gwa Ruhanga,
Ija onyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may lead others to love and serve:
Kugira ngu ndebembe abandi kukunda n'okuheereza iwe,
Ija omu kuhwera kwangye, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.That I may labor zealously to eradicate:
Nimbaasa kukora n'obweziriki kumaraho emicwe yangye mibi,
Omwana w'omukazi owa rukundo, nyamba.
content-rny.In all necessities of body and soul,\nCo:
Omu byetengo byona eby'omubiri hamwe n'omutima,
Nkweshengyereza, nyine maama orikukunda.
content-rny.In poverty and distress,\nCome to my aid:
Omu bworo n'obusaasi,
Ija omu nyambaho, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.In persecution and abandonment,\nCome to:
Omu kubonabona n'okunagaijurwa,
Ija omu bwire bwangye, O Maama w'omukago.
content-rny.In sickness and pain,\nCome to my aid, O:
Omu burwaire n'obusaasi,
Ija omu buhwezi bwangye, O Maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.When assailed by the evil spirits,\nCome:
Ku ndaaba ninteerwa emyoyo emibi,
Nkweshengyereza nyina wangye omukundwa.
content-rny.In every danger of sin,\nCome to my aid,:
Buri kabi koona akarikukwata aha kibi,
Ija onyambe, Nyina w'okugonza.
content-rny.In time of war, famine and contagion,\nC:
Omu bwire bw'orutaro, enjara hamwe n'endwara,
Ija omu buhwezi bwangye, O maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.In grief and dereliction of mind,\nCome:
Omu kushoberwa n'okuhwa amaani,
Nkweshengyereza okunyamba, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.When death is nigh,\nCome to my aid, O l:
Okufa ku kuraabe kuri haihi,
Ija onyambe, nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.When struggling against the inclinations:
Ku ndikurwanisa okwenda kw'omutima gwangye ogw'obushuma,
Nkweshengyereza, Maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.When tempted by the allurements of a dec:
Ku orikugyezibwa okukora ebintu by'ensi egi erimu oburyarya,
Nkweshengyereza nyine maama w'okundinda.
content-rny.When tempted against the holy virtue of:
Ku orikugyezibwa aha kushemeza kw'oburungi bw'okwera,
Ija omuyambe, Nyina wangye ow'okukunda.
content-rny.When the loss of my senses\nshall warn m:
Obu okufeerwa kw'obwengye bwangye
kuraabe nikunyoreka ngu omurimo gwangye ogw'omu nsi guri aha muheru,
Ija onyambe, O Maama w'okukunda.
content-rny.When the priest of God shall give me\nhi:
Omubuurizi wa Ruhanga ku araaheze
okunyihaho ebibi bye n'omugisha gwe,
Ija omumpwere obuhwezi, Nyina wangye ow'okukunda.
content-rny.When the thought of my approaching disso:
Ku ndikuteekateeka aha kushenyuka kwangye
kuriija kunshemeza n'obutiini hamwe n'okutiina,
Ija omu maisho gangye, O Maama w'omukundwa.
content-rny.When at the decisive hour of death,\nthe:
Ku ndikuba ndi omu shaaha y'okufa,
omwoyo mubi nigwija kugyezaho kutuma omwoyo gwangye guhwa amaani,
Ija onyambe, Nyina wangye orikukunda.
content-rny.When I shall yield my soul into the hand:
Ku ndaheereze omwoyo gwangye omu mikono y'Omuhangi waagwo,
Ija okunyamba, Nyina wangye ow'okukunda.
content-rny.When my soul will appear before its Sove:
Omwoyo gwangye ku guraareebekye omu maisho ga Omucwi w'Emishango,
Ija onyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.When the world will vanish from my sight:
Obu ensi eraija kuhwaho omu maisho gangye,
kandi omutima gwangye guhwe kuteera,
Ija okunyambere, Owaanyinabukundwa.
content-rny.When my friends and relations,\nsurround:
Abanywani bangye hamwe n'abanywani,
barikwetoorora ekitanda kyangye,
baakoresa embabazi,
babaase kukushaba okunshazira,
Oyambe, Nyina w'okukunda.
content-rny.Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of:
Omwana gw'entaama, orikwiha ebibi by'ensi,
Twikirize, Mukama.
content-rny.When the irrevocable sentence will be pr:
Ku orikwija kugamba ekigambo ky'okusharaho,
Ija omu mbabazi zangye, Nyina w'omukundwa.
content-rny.When I will be suffering in Purgatory,\n:
Ku ndaabe ninyija kuba nintuntuura omu purigatori,
kandi ndikweteekateekyera okureeba Ruhanga,
Ija onnyambe, Owaanyinaze ow'okukunda.
content-rny.Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of:
Omwana gw'entaama, orikwihaho ebibi by'ensi,
Mukama w'embabazi, tuhurire.

Omwana wa Ruhanga, orikwihaho ebibi by'ensi,
Tugirire embabazi.
content-rny.O Mother of Perpetual Help, grant that I: O Maama w'obuhwezi obutahwaho, mpereza ngu nshemereire kushaba eiziina ryawe ery'amaani, okurinda abahuriire hamwe n'okukiza abarikufa.
content-rny.Purest Mary, let your name henceforth be: Purest Mary, reka eiziina ryawe kuruga hati rishemereire kuba aha mimwa yangye. Otakyerererwa, Omukazi Orikwera, okunkiza buri murundi ogu ndikukushaba.
content-rny.In my temptations, in my needs, I will n: Omu kwohibwa kwangye, omu byetengo byangye, tindikwija kuhwa kukushaba, ndikugarukamu eiziina ryawe ery'ekitiinisa, Mariya, Mariya.
content-rny.O Almighty and merciful God, Who, in ord: Owa Ruhanga ow'amaani kandi ow'embabazi, Orikwenda kuhwera abantu, okasharamu omukazi w'omugisha Mariya kuba Maama w'Omwana waawe omwe wenka, tuheereze, nitushaba ngu kurabira omu kushaba kwe, twetantare ekibi kandi tukuheereze n'omutima ogurikwera, kurabira omuri Kristo Mukama waitu.
content-rny.What a consolation, what sweetness, what: N'eky'okuhuumuriza, n'oburungi, n'obwesigye oburikwijura omu mutima gwangye ku ndikugamba eiziina ryawe eririkwera nainga n'obu ndaabe ninteekateeka ahariiwe! Ninsiima Mukama ahabw'okukuha eiziina rirungi munonga, ery'amaani, kandi eririkushemeza.
content-rny.But I will not be content with merely ut: Kwonka tindikwija kumarwa n'okugamba eiziina ryawe. Ka rukundo yangye ahabwawe entebekanise okukusiima iwe Maama w'Obuhwezi Obutahwaho. Maama w'Obuhwezi Obutahwaho, nsabira kandi ompe oburungi obu ndikushaba kuruga ahariiwe
content-rny.which I ask of thee in this novena, for: eki ndikukushaba omu novena egi, ahabw'ekitiinisa kya Ruhanga ekirikukirayo obwingi, ahabw'ekitiinisa kyawe hamwe n'oburungi bw'abantu boona.
content-rny.Our Father,\nHail Mary\nGlory Be\n(three:
Taata waitu,
Hail Mary
Ekitiinisa kibe
(emirundi eshatu buri kamwe)
content-rny.Most Holy Virgin, who deigned to come to: Ow'omutaano Omukazi Orikwera, owahaireyo kwija Fatima kushoboororera abashaija bashatu bato abariisa eby'obugaiga by'embabazi ebisherekirwe omu kugarukamu kwa Rosary, aheereze emitima yaitu okukunda okurungi okw'okwehayo oku, kugira ngu turikuteekateeka aha by'okucungurwa kwaitu ebirikwijukwa omuri kwo, tubaase kurundaana ebijuma kandi tufune okuhinduka kw'abasiisi, okuhinduka kwa Russia hamwe n'ekigyendererwa eki ndikuronda n'amaani maingi,
content-rny.O renowned champion of the faith of Chri: Omweshongozi w'amaani ow'okwikiriza kwa Kristo, omuramuzi orikwera munonga Dominic, owaayehaireyo okurekura ekitiinisa n'obugabe bw'obutegyeki bw'ensi kugira ngu akwatanise n'abooro, abarikukora munonga, hamwe n'amagara g'okubonabonesibwa agarikushemereire kutaanisa omwegi wa We Owaagambire ati: Omuntu weena ku araabe naayenda kwija enyima yangye, areke atware omusaraba gwe kandi amukurate.
content-rny.Thou, O great Saint, regardest as nothin: Iwe, O Saint mukuru, nooreeba nk'ekitari kikuru okubonabona kwona oku waagumireho, hamwe n'okukora munonga oku waakozire ahabw'okutunguura omurimo gwa Ruhanga ogurikwera; nkweshengyereza, ngu rukundo ei yaakuhaire amaani, ekunde kushemeza emirimo yangye, okuswazibwa, okuswazibwa, nainga okubonabona okundi kwona oku ndikubaasa kubonabona ahabw'eiziina rya Yesu.
content-rny.My God, I believe, I adore, I hope and I: Ruhanga wangye, ninyikiriza, ninkunda munonga, ninteekateeka kandi ninkukunda! Ninkushaba okusaasirwa ahabw'abo abatarikwikiriza, abatarikukunda munonga, abatarikuteekateeka kandi abatarikukunda. Ruhanga Orikwera Omurundi Gwakashatu, Taata, Omwana hamwe n'Omwoyo Orikwera, ninkukunda munonga, kandi ninkuha Omubiri ogurikukirayo oburungi, Esagama, Omwoyo hamwe n'Oburungi bwa Yesu Kristo, oburi omu myanya yoona y'ensi, omu kuhayo ahabw'okutwarwa kubi, okujumirirwa hamwe n'obutafayo obu Arikugambwaho. Kandi, kurabira omu migasho etarikuhwaho ey'omutima gwe ogurikwera munonga, hamwe n'omutima ogutarimu kibi ogwa Mariya, ninkushaba ngu ohindure abasiisi abooro.
content-rny.O burning torch, who being thyself consu: Otoro y'okwosya, orikuba ori iwe wenka oyokirwe omuriro gw'okukunda kwa Ruhanga, okakora butoosha kushemeza omuriro ogwo ogurikwera omu mitima y'abandi, reeba ahansi aha ntebe y'ekitiinisa ei orikushemerererwamu omugisha gw'emirimo yaawe yoona, kandi otungye ngu obucweka bw'omuriro ogwo ogurikwera bugume bukashemereire omu mutima gwangye, kugira ngu buhimbise kandi buhagarike omu mihanda yoona nainga okugyezibwa oku kirikushemeza oburungi bwa Ruhanga kubungira.
content-rny.I praise and thank God for the high degr: Ninshaba kandi ninsiima Ruhanga ahabw'okukuhindura omuntu w'omugasho munonga, hamwe n'emigisha y'omutaano ei yaakuhaire.
content-rny.O tender Father of the poor who, when al: O taata w'abooro owaahaireyo, obu ebindi byona byahwaho, akahaayo ahabwabo kubahuumuriza, mpisye omwoyo gw'amazima ogw'embabazi aha bantu ba Yesu Kristo abarikubonabona, ogwabaire guriho omu magara gaawe amagororo.
content-rny.May I, by charity to those whom Jesus so: Nimbaasa, kurabira omu kugaba aha bantu abu Yesu akunda munonga, nteekye eby'obutungi omu iguru, ahu orikushemererwa hati ebi amaisho gataraareebire, nainga okutu kutahuriire, nainga omutima gw'omuntu gutarateekateeka, kwonka eki Ruhanga atebeekanisiize abarikumukunda, kandi abarikworeka ngu nibo Beegi be barikurinda ebiragiro bye by'Obuhangwa: kukundana.
content-rny.May I ever bear in mind that nothing can: Nimbaasa kuguma ninteekateeka ngu tihariho ekirikubaasa kubaho ahariinye okwihaho kurabira omu muringo gw'omutaano ogwa Ruhanga orikwetegyereza munonga, kandi ahabw'ekyo naamanya ekirikukirayo oburungi ahabw'oburungi bwangye; ow'amaani munonga, kandi ahabw'ekyo naabaasa kukikora; kandi ekirikukirayo byona, ow'embabazi n'okukunda munonga, owaataireho amagara ge ahabw'okucungurwa kwangye, kandi akagumizamu buriizooba kuheereza obuhame busya bw'okukunda kwe hamwe n'embabazi ze.
content-rny.Obtain likewise the favours I request in: Kandi oshabe okushaba kwangye omu Novena egi, kurabira omu kushaba kwaawe okw'amaani.
content-rny.I ask thee, by that gratitude with which: Ninkushaba, ahabw'okusiima oku orikwija kuguma oine obwire bwona ahabwa Omuhangi waawe ow'Oburungi, nshaba ngu ompabure embabazi z'okwiha omu mutima gwangye ekintu kyona ekitarikwikirizibwa omu maisho ge, okukira munonga omuze ogwo ogubi ogu ndikukira kumushiisha.
content-rny.I sincerely desire from this moment to l: Ninyenda munonga kuruga omu bwire obu kukunda We n'omutima gwangye gwona, kandi ndikumuheereza n'amaani gangye goona, kandi hati nintaho oburinzi bwawe obw'amaani, nk'omuringo ogurikwesigwa gw'okutunga emigisha yoona erikwetengwa kumuheereza omu bwesigwa aha, ngu mpore okushemererwa nawe omu biro byona. Amen.
content-rny.O glorious Mother of God, Queen of the m: O nyina w'ekitiinisa, Omugabekazi w'omusaraba ogurikwera munonga, iwe owaakunzire Dominic n'okukunda kw'omukazi, kandi akakundwa munonga kandi yaheebwa ekitiinisa, ndeeba ahabwe, n'amaisho g'obusaasi, okikirize kwegaita nawe omu kushaba okushaba oku ahari Yesu waawe owahairwe omugisha.
content-rny.O sorrowful Mother, I turn to you in tot: Maama w'obusaasi, ninkuhindukira omu bwesigye bwona. Okabonabona obusaasi oburikukirayo omu magara gaawe, orikureeba Omwana waawe arikufa aha Musaraba, kandi okaguma ori nawe kuhisya aha muheru.
content-rny.Look with favor upon me, a poor sinner,: Mpa okushemererwa, omusiisi w'obusaasi, kandi ongabire kuruga aha Mwana waawe obugabe bwona obu ndikwetenga kugumisiriza okubonabona oku Ruhanga arikunyikiriza kubonabona.
content-rny.On the Cross her Son was dying.\nMary st:
Aha musaraba, Omwana we akaba ariyo naafa.
Mariamu akemera ahansi ye arikurira,
Arikugabana omu musaraba gw'okukiza kwe.
Obu yaabaire ayehingirire, omwoyo gwe gukaba nigushasha, kandi ekitala kikaba nikishara omutima gwe,
kandi akarira okufeerwa okw'obusaasi.
content-rny.O Mother of Sorrows, through thy First S: O Maama w'Okushoberwa, kurabira omu Kushoberwa kwawe okw'okubanza, Okuragura kwa Simeoni Orikwera, ongambire n'omutima gwa Yesu ogurikwera, kandi ompa embabazi ezi ndikushaba
content-rny.O Mother of the Word Incarnate, despise: O Maama w'ekigambo ekirugire omu kishushani, otashisha okushaba kwangye, kureka omu busingye bwawe, mpurira kandi ongambire. Amen.
content-rny.Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary, t: Ijuka, O Mariamu Omukazi w'ekitiinisa, ngu tikirikamanywa ngu omuntu weena owahungiire omu burinzi bwawe, akashaba obuhwezi bwawe nainga akasherura okushaba kwawe, akasigara ataine buhwezi. Ahabw'okugira obwesigye obu, ninkwirukirira, O Mariamu w'Abakazi b'Obusugi, Maama wangye. Ninkwija ahariiwe, omu maisho gaawe ndiyo nyemereire, ndi omunyabibi kandi ndi omu kuhwa amaani.

billing.signInFirst.en: Create a free account to start your 7-day free trial.

billing.methodsAbroad.en: Pay with Visa or Mastercard. Payments are handled securely by PesaPal.

routine.description.en: Choose the prayers you want to pray each day and week.

routine.promptShort.en: Get suggested daily and weekly prayers

routine.fullDescription.en: Morning, midday and night prayers and the Rosary every day, with the Divine Mercy Chaplet on Fridays.
routine.fullDescription.text: Sala za asubuhi, adhuhuri na usiku pamoja na Tasbihi kila siku, na Tasbihi ya Rehema ya Mungu siku za Ijumaa.

favourites.empty.en: Use "Save to favourites" on any prayer to keep it here.

reminders.signIn.en: Sign in to get reminders for your routine.

ambaye jina lake linaleta uhakika,

content-sw.That I may love God with all my heart,\n:
Ili niweze kumpenda Mungu kwa moyo wangu wote,

content-sw.That I may always shun sin, the only rea:
Ili niweze kuepuka dhambi, uovu pekee wa kweli,

content-sw.That I may always remember my last end,\:
Ili niweze kukumbuka mwisho wangu wa mwisho daima,

content-sw.That I may in all things conform my will:
Ili katika mambo yote nifanye mapenzi yangu
yalingane na ya Mwana wako wa Kimungu,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.That I may often and devoutly receive th:
Ili niweze kupokea mara kwa mara na kwa bidii Sakramenti,

content-sw.That I may never neglect prayer,\nCome t:
Ili nisipuuze kamwe sala,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.That I may always be victorious in the h:
Ili niweze kushinda daima wakati wa jaribu,

content-sw.That I may ever remember to invoke thee,:
Ili niweze kukumbuka kukuomba,
hasa wakati wa majaribu,

content-sw.That I may avoid every proximate occasio:
Ili niweze kuepuka kila tukio la karibu la dhambi,

content-sw.That I may courageously resist the seduc:
Ili niweze kukataa kwa ujasiri vishawishi vya marafiki waovu,
Nisaidie, Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.That I may generously pardon my enemies,:
Ili niweze kuwasamehe adui zangu kwa ukarimu,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.That I may arise quickly,\nshould I have:
Ili niweze kuinuka haraka,
kama nitapatwa na bahati mbaya ya kuanguka katika dhambi ya kifo,

content-sw.That I may be strong against my own inco:
Ili niwe na nguvu dhidi ya kutokuwa mwaminifu kwangu mwenyewe,

content-sw.That I may not delay my conversion from:

content-sw.That I may ever love to serve thee,\nCom:

content-sw.That I may lead others to love and serve:
Ili niweze kuwaongoza wengine kupenda na kukutumikia,

content-sw.That I may labor zealously to eradicate:
Ili niweze kufanya kazi kwa bidii ili kuondoa tabia zangu mbaya,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.That I may live and die in the friendshi:
Ili niishi na kufa katika urafiki wa Mungu,
Nisaidie, Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.In all necessities of body and soul,\nCo:
Katika mahitaji yote ya mwili na roho,

content-sw.In poverty and distress,\nCome to my aid:
Katika umaskini na taabu,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.In sickness and pain,\nCome to my aid, O:
Katika ugonjwa na maumivu,

content-sw.In grief and dereliction of mind,\nCome:

content-sw.In persecution and abandonment,\nCome to:

Nisaidie, Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.In time of war, famine and contagion,\nC:
Wakati wa vita, njaa na maambukizi,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mwenye upendo.
content-sw.In every danger of sin,\nCome to my aid,:
Katika kila hatari ya dhambi,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mwenye upendo.
content-sw.When assailed by the evil spirits,\nCome:
Wakati niliposhambuliwa na roho waovu,
Nisaidie, Ee Mama mpendwa.
content-sw.When tempted against the holy virtue of:

content-sw.When struggling against the inclinations:
Wakati wa kupambana na mwelekeo wa tabia yangu yenye ufisadi,

content-sw.When tempted by the allurements of a dec:
Unaposhawishiwa na vishawishi vya ulimwengu wenye udanganyifu,

content-sw.When death is nigh,\nCome to my aid, O l:

Wakati nitakapotoa nafsi yangu mikononi mwa Muumba wake,

content-sw.When the world will vanish from my sight:

content-sw.When my friends and relations,\nsurround:

wakizunguka kitanda changu, wakisogea kwa huruma,
wataomba msamaha wako kwa niaba yangu,

Wakati nafsi yangu itakapotokea mbele ya Hakimu Mkuu wake,

content-sw.When the irrevocable sentence will be pr:

content-sw.O Almighty and merciful God, Who, in ord: Ee Mungu Mweza Yote na mwenye rehema, Ambaye, ili kuwasaidia wanadamu, umemchagua Bikira Maria Mtakatifu awe Mama wa Mwana wako mzaliwa pekee, tunakuomba utupe neema ya kuepuka dhambi kupitia mwombaji wake na tukutumikie kwa moyo safi, kupitia Kristo Bwana wetu.
content-sw.O Mother of Perpetual Help, grant that I: Ewe Mama wa Msaada wa Kudumu, nipe uwezo wa kuita jina lako lenye nguvu, ulinzi kwa walio hai na wokovu kwa wanaokufa.
content-sw.Purest Mary, let your name henceforth be: Mary Mtakatifu, jina lako na liwe kwenye midomo yangu daima. Usikawie, Mama Mtakatifu, kunisaidia wakati wowote nitakapokuita.
content-sw.In my temptations, in my needs, I will n: Katika majaribu yangu, katika mahitaji yangu, sitaacha kamwe kukuita, nikirudia jina lako takatifu, Mariamu, Mariamu.
content-sw.What a consolation, what sweetness, what: Ni faraja kama nini, utamu gani, uhakika gani unaojaza nafsi yangu ninaposema jina lako takatifu au hata nikikufikiria tu! Namshukuru Bwana kwa kunipa jina tamu sana, lenye nguvu na zuri mno.
content-sw.But I will not be content with merely ut: Lakini sitaridhika tu kwa kutamka jina lako. Acha upendo wangu kwako uniwezeshe kukuabudu daima Mama wa Msaada wa Kudumu. Mama wa Msaada wa Kudumu, nisali na unipe neema ninayokuomba kwa ujasiri

content-sw.“Today bring to Me all mankind, especial: “Leo nileteeni wanadamu wote, hasa watenda dhambi wote, na muwazamishe katika bahari ya rehema yangu. Kwa njia hii mtaniwezesha kufariji katika maumivu makali ambayo kupoteza nafsi kunanifanya nipitie.”
content-sw.Eternal Father, turn Your merciful gaze: Baba wa Milele, geuza macho yako ya rehema kwa wanadamu wote na hasa kwa watenda dhambi maskini, wote waliokumbatiwa katika Moyo wa Huruma Zaidi wa Yesu. Kwa ajili ya mateso Yake yenye huzuni tuonyeshe rehema zako, ili tuisifu nguvu zisizo na mipaka za rehema zako milele na milele. Amina.
content-sw.Pray the Divine Mercy Chaplet. You can u: Sali Chapleti ya Rehema ya Kimungu. Unaweza kutumia shanga za kawaida za Tasbihi.
content-sw.Most Merciful Jesus, whose very nature i: Yesu Mwenye Rehema Zaidi, ambaye asili yake ni kuwa na huruma kwetu na kutusamehe, usiangalie dhambi zetu bali imani yetu tunayoiweka katika wema Wako usio na mipaka. Tukubali sote kwenye makao ya Moyo Wako Mwenye Huruma Kubwa, na usiruhusu kamwe tuponyoke Kwake. Twakuomba hili kupitia upendo Wako unaounganisha Wewe na Baba na Roho Mtakatifu.

content-sw.You expired, Jesus, but the source of li: Uliisha muda wako, Yesu, lakini chanzo cha uhai kilimwagika kwa nafsi, na bahari ya rehema ilifunguka kwa ulimwengu mzima. Ee Chemchemi ya Uhai, Rehema Takatifu isiyo na kikomo, funika ulimwengu mzima na ujaze nafsi zako juu yetu.
content-sw.O Blood and Water, which gushed forth fr: Ewe Damu na Maji, ambayo yalimwagika kutoka kwa Moyo wa Yesu kama chemchemi ya rehema kwetu, nakutegemea Wewe! (mara tatu)

content-sw.Eternal God, in whom mercy is endless an: Mungu wa Milele, ambaye rehema yake haina mwisho na hazina ya huruma isiyoisha, tutazame kwa fadhili na uongeze rehema Yako ndani yetu, ili katika nyakati ngumu tusikate tamaa wala kukata tamaa kabisa, bali tukijiaminisha sana kwenye mapenzi Yako matakatifu, ambayo ni Upendo na Huruma yenyewe.
content-sw.O Jesus, eternal Truth, our Life, I call: Ee Yesu, Kweli ya milele, Uhai wetu, nakuita na kuomba rehema yako kwa wakosefu maskini. Ee Moyo Mtakatifu zaidi wa Bwana wangu, uliojaa huruma na rehema isiyoelezeka, nakuomba kwa ajili ya wakosefu maskini. Ee Moyo Mtakatifu Zaidi, Chanzo cha Rehema ambacho kinatiririsha miale ya neema zisizoweza kufikiriwa kwa jamii nzima ya binadamu, nakuomba mwanga kwa ajili ya wakosefu maskini. Ee Yesu, kumbuka Shida Yako kubwa na usiruhusu kupotea kwa nafsi zilizokombolewa kwa bei ghali ya Damu Yako yenye thamani kubwa. Ee Yesu, ninapofikiria bei kubwa ya Damu Yako, nafurahia ukubwa wake, kwani tone moja tu lingetosha kwa wokovu wa wakosefu wote. Ingawa dhambi ni shimo la uovu na kukosa shukrani, bei iliyolipwa kwa ajili yetu haiwezi kulinganishwa. Kwa hivyo, acheni kila nafsi itumaini Shida ya Bwana, na iweke matumaini yake katika rehema Yake. Mungu hatakataa rehema Yake kwa mtu yeyote. Mbingu na dunia zinaweza kubadilika, lakini rehema ya Mungu haitakoma kamwe. Ah, ni furaha kubwa gani inayowaka moyoni mwangu ninapofikiria wema Wako usioeleweka, Ee Yesu! Natamani kuwaleta wakosefu wote mbele ya miguu Yako ili watukuze rehema Yako kwa umilele wote (Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska, 72).
content-sw.Most holy Apostle, St. Jude, faithful se: Mtakatifu Mtume, Mt. Yuda, mtumishi mwaminifu na rafiki wa Yesu, Kanisa linakuheshimu na kukuita duniani kote, kama mlinzi wa kesi ngumu, za mambo ambayo karibu yamekata tamaa.
content-sw.Pray for me, as I feel helpless and alon: Nisali, kwa kuwa nahisi nikiwa mpweke na hoi.
content-sw.Intercede with God for me that He bring: Niombe kwa Mungu anisaidie ili alete msaada wa haraka na unaonekana pale ambapo msaada unakaribia kukosa matumaini. Nisaidie katika uhitaji huu mkubwa ili nipate faraja na msaada wa mbinguni katika mahitaji yangu yote, dhiki, na mateso, hasa:
content-sw.May the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus be ad: Moyo Mtakatifu Zaidi wa Yesu uabudiwe na kupendwa katika madhabahu yote hadi mwisho wa wakati. Amina.
content-sw.and that I may praise God with you and a: na ili niweze kumsifu Mungu pamoja nawe na watakatifu wote milele. Naahidi, Mtakatifu Yuda Aliyebarikiwa, kuendelea kukumbuka fadhila hii kubwa niliyopewa na Mungu na kuheshimu daima wewe kama mlinzi wangu maalum na mwenye nguvu, na kutia moyo kwa shukrani ujitoaji kwako.
content-sw.May the most Sacred Heart of Jesus be pr: Moyo Mtakatifu Zaidi wa Yesu na usifiwe na utukuzwe sasa na milele. Amina.
content-sw.St. Jude pray for me and hear my prayers: Mtakatifu Yuda anisali na asikilize sala zangu. Amina.
content-sw.O Greatly Merciful God, Infinite Goodnes: Ee Mungu Mwenye Rehema Kuu, Wema Usio na Mipaka, leo wanadamu wote wanaita kutoka katika shimo la taabu zao kwa rehema Yako, kwa huruma Yako, Ee Mungu; na wanalia kwa sauti yao kubwa ya taabu. Mungu mwenye neema, usikatae sala ya wahamiaji wa dunia hii! Ee Bwana, Wema uliopita uelewa wetu, Ambaye anajua taabu zetu kikamilifu, na kujua kwamba kwa nguvu zetu hatuwezi kukupanda, tunakuomba: tutangulie kwa neema Yako na kuendelea kuongeza rehema Yako ndani yetu, ili tuweze kufanya mapenzi Yako matakatifu kwa uaminifu maisha yetu yote na wakati wa kifo. Acha nguvu za rehema Yako zitulinde dhidi ya mishale ya adui za wokovu wetu, ili tuweze kwa uhakika, kama watoto Wako, kusubiri kuja Kwako [Mwana], siku inayojulikana na Wewe pekee. Na tunatarajia kupata kila kitu tulichoahidiwa na Yesu licha ya taabu zetu zote. Kwa sababu Yesu ni Tumaini letu: kupitia moyo Wake wenye rehema, kama kupitia mlango uliofunguliwa, tunapita hadi mbinguni (Diary, 1570).
Ibara iwe kwa moyo mtakatifu wa Maria.
content-sw.Blessed be St. Jude Thaddeus, in all the: Atabarikiwe Mtakatifu Jude Thaddeus, katika dunia yote na kwa Umilele wote.
